hints: Look at... 和下一句 He is drinking 提示要用什麼時態？
Two of them 和 the other one 各是幾個人？
swim、sit 加 ing 時，字尾子音要不要重複？

wrong.D: Two of them 是兩個人，要用 are；the other one 只有一個人，要用 is。
wrong.B: swim、sit 都是「短母音 + 單一子音」結尾，加 ing 前要重複字尾子音：swimming、sitting。
wrong.A: Look at... 表示眼前正在發生的動作，要用現在進行式，而且下一句也用 is drinking。

stem:
City Library Rules
1. Don't eat or drink near the computers.
2. Talk quietly. People are reading.
3. Put the books on the front desk after reading.

A girl is drinking juice at a computer. She isn't talking, and her books are already on the front desk. What is the librarian probably saying to her?
options: Please sit at the computer and drink.
Please put the books on the front desk.
explanation: 女孩正在電腦旁喝果汁（is drinking juice at a computer），違反第 1 條 Don't eat or drink near the computers.。她沒有講話、書也已經放好，所以館員最可能用祈使句請她把果汁拿到外面：Please take your juice outside.
hints: 女孩現在正在做哪些事？
把她的行為和三條規則一一對照，她違反了哪一條？
館員要她做的事，應該能解決她違反的那條規則。

wrong.B: 題目說她沒有在講話，沒有違反第 2 條規則。
wrong.D: 她的書已經放在服務台上了，沒有違反第 3 條規則。
wrong.C: 第 1 條規則說不可以在電腦旁邊吃喝，這句話剛好和規則相反。

stem:
It's the first class of the day, and the students are noisy.
Ms. Wang: Good morning, class. Please be quiet and (1)＿＿＿ your books to page 20. Tim, you are talking to Joe again. (2)＿＿＿ talk in class. Listen to me, please.
Tim: Sorry, Ms. Wang. I'm listening now.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: 老師在下指令，用祈使句（原形動詞開頭）。(1) and 連接 be quiet 和另一個指令，兩者都是原形，所以是 open your books。(2) 老師要 Tim 不要在課堂上說話，否定祈使句是 Don't + 原形動詞：Don't talk in class.
hints: 老師說這些話是在描述事情，還是在要求學生做事？
and 前面的 be quiet 是什麼形式？後面的動詞要和它一樣嗎？
否定的祈使句要用哪個字開頭？

wrong.B: 祈使句用原形動詞，and 前面的 be quiet 是原形，後面的動詞也要用原形 open。
wrong.A: 祈使句沒有主詞，否定時用 Don't，不用第三人稱單數的 Doesn't。
wrong.C: 祈使句不能用 V-ing；否定祈使句也不能只用 Not 開頭。

stem:
Dear Andy,
I'm at Grandma's house now. She is sick, and I am taking care of her. Dad is working late tonight, so please make some noodles for dinner. Feed the cat at six, and don't open the door for strangers. Do your homework first, and then you can play video games. See you tomorrow morning!
Love,
Mom

Which is NOT something Mom asks Andy to do?
explanation: 媽媽用祈使句交代 Andy：煮麵當晚餐、六點餵貓、不要幫陌生人開門、先寫功課再玩遊戲。媽媽自己在奶奶家照顧奶奶，並沒有要 Andy 去探望奶奶，所以「今晚去看奶奶」不是媽媽要他做的事。題目問 NOT，選這一項。
hints: 題目問的是「沒有」要 Andy 做的事。
把紙條裡以原形動詞開頭的句子都圈出來。
在奶奶家的人是誰？媽媽有叫 Andy 過去嗎？

wrong.D: 媽媽寫了 please make some noodles for dinner，這是她交代的事。
wrong.C: 媽媽寫了 Feed the cat at six，這是她交代的事。
wrong.B: Do your homework first, and then you can play video games. 就是先寫功課再玩遊戲，是媽媽交代的事。

stem:
Dad: Hi, Jenny. Where are you?
Jenny: I'm at the bookstore with Lucy. We're looking for a dictionary for our English class.
Dad: Is your brother with you?
Jenny: No. He's at the park. He and his friends are playing basketball there.
Dad: OK. Please come home before six. We're having dinner at Grandma's house tonight. Don't be late!

Which is TRUE?
options: Jenny's brother is at the bookstore.
Lucy is buying a dictionary for Dad.
Jenny is playing basketball with Lucy.
The family is having dinner at Grandma's house tonight.
explanation: 爸爸說 We're having dinner at Grandma's house tonight.，現在進行式也可以表示已經安排好的計畫，意思是今晚全家要去奶奶家吃晚餐。其他選項：Jenny 和 Lucy 在書店、哥哥（弟弟）在公園打籃球、字典是英文課要用的。
hints: Jenny 和 Lucy 在哪裡？在做什麼？
Jenny 的兄弟在哪裡？
爸爸最後提到今晚的什麼安排？

wrong.C: Jenny 和 Lucy 在書店找字典；打籃球的是 Jenny 的哥哥（弟弟）和他的朋友。
wrong.A: Jenny 說 No. He's at the park.，哥哥（弟弟）在公園。
wrong.B: 字典是她們英文課要用的，和爸爸無關。

stem:
My cousin Leo (1)＿＿＿ in Kaohsiung. He and his parents (2)＿＿＿ near a big park, so they often go jogging there in the morning. Leo's sister, Mia, doesn't go with them. She always sleeps late on weekends, and she doesn't like sports.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: 這段話描述長期的事實和習慣，用現在簡單式。(1) 主詞 My cousin Leo 是第三人稱單數，動詞加 s：lives。(2) 主詞 He and his parents 是複數，動詞用原形 live。
hints: 這段文章說的是現在正在發生的事，還是平常的事實？
(1) 和 (2) 的主詞分別是單數還是複數？
He and his parents 一共有幾個人？

wrong.D: 把兩格顛倒了：(1) 主詞 Leo 是第三人稱單數要加 s，(2) 主詞是複數不加 s。
wrong.A: (2) 的主詞是 He and his parents（三個人），是複數，動詞不加 s。
wrong.B: living 前面沒有 be 動詞，不能當句子的動詞。

stem:
Sue: (1)＿＿＿ you and your brother go to the same school?
Tom: No. I go to Sunshine Junior High School, but he (2)＿＿＿. He is only nine, so he goes to Hope Elementary School.
Sue: How does he get there?
Tom: My dad drives him there every morning.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 句中有一般動詞 go，疑問句要用助動詞；主詞 you and your brother 是複數，用 Do。(2) but he doesn't 是 but he doesn't go to Sunshine Junior High School 的省略，主詞 he 是第三人稱單數，用 doesn't。後面說他去 Hope Elementary School，可以印證是否定。
hints: (1) 句子的動詞 go 是一般動詞還是 be 動詞？主詞有幾個人？
(2) 省略了哪些字？他到底有沒有去 Sunshine Junior High？
he 用的助動詞否定是哪一個？

wrong.D: (1) 的主詞是 you and your brother 兩個人，是複數，要用 Do。
wrong.B: (2) 的主詞 he 是第三人稱單數，否定要用 doesn't。
wrong.C: (2) 要代替前面的一般動詞 go（他不去那所學校），要用助動詞 doesn't，不能用 be 動詞。

stem:
Here is Amy's after-school plan:
Monday: swimming
Tuesday: piano lesson
Wednesday: swimming
Thursday: piano lesson
Friday: swimming
Saturday: piano lesson and swimming
Sunday: nothing; she stays home with her family

Which is TRUE about Amy?
options: She always goes swimming on Sundays.
She has piano lessons four times a week.
She swims four times a week.
explanation: 游泳的日子有星期一、三、五、六，共 4 天，所以一週游泳 4 次（four times a week）。鋼琴課是星期二、四、六，共 3 次；星期六有游泳，所以週末不是從不游泳；星期天在家。
hints: 分別數一數游泳和鋼琴課各有幾天。
週末指的是哪兩天？
never 和 always 的意思分別是什麼？

wrong.A: 星期六也有游泳，所以不是週末從不游泳。
wrong.C: 鋼琴課只有星期二、四、六，一週三次。
wrong.B: 星期天她什麼都不安排，待在家裡陪家人。

stem:
Joe likes reading very much. He goes to the library on Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays. But he doesn't like sports. He goes to the gym only once a month with his father. So Joe (1)＿＿＿ goes to the library, but he (2)＿＿＿ goes to the gym.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: Joe 一週有四天去圖書館，是「常常」去，用 often；健身房一個月只去一次，是「很少」去，用 seldom。always 表示每次都，never 表示從不，都和文章不符。
hints: Joe 一週去幾次圖書館？一個月去幾次健身房？
but 前後的意思相同還是相反？
比較 always、often、seldom、never 的頻率高低。

wrong.D: 把兩格顛倒了：一週去四天圖書館是常常去，一個月才去一次健身房是很少去。
wrong.A: Joe 不是每天都去圖書館，不能用 always；一個月去一次健身房也不是 never（從不）。
wrong.C: Joe 一週去四次圖書館，不能說從不去；一個月一次健身房也不是「通常」。

stem:
Hi, I'm Kenji. I live in Osaka with my parents and my grandma. My father works at a bank, and my mother teaches art at a high school. Every morning, my grandma gets up at five and takes a walk in the park. I get up at six thirty and have breakfast with my parents. On weekends, my father and I often go fishing, but my mother never goes with us. She doesn't like fish! She usually paints at home.

Which is TRUE about Kenji's family?
options: Kenji's father is an art teacher.
Kenji's mother often goes fishing on weekends.
Kenji's grandma gets up before Kenji.
Kenji goes fishing with his mother on weekends.
explanation: 奶奶每天早上 5 點起床，Kenji 6 點半起床，所以奶奶比 Kenji 先起床。媽媽從不去釣魚（never goes with us）、教美術的是媽媽、和 Kenji 去釣魚的是爸爸。
hints: 奶奶和 Kenji 各是幾點起床？
週末誰和 Kenji 去釣魚？媽媽做什麼？
誰在銀行工作？誰教美術？

wrong.B: 文中說 my mother never goes with us，媽媽從不去釣魚。
wrong.A: 爸爸在銀行工作，教美術的是媽媽。
wrong.D: 週末和 Kenji 去釣魚的是爸爸，媽媽在家畫畫。

stem:
Bus 25: City Hall to Sunny Zoo
Weekdays: every 30 minutes, from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.
Weekends: every 20 minutes, from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
The trip takes 40 minutes.

It is Saturday. Amy gets to City Hall at 7:10 a.m. and takes the next Bus 25. What time does she get to Sunny Zoo?
explanation: 星期六是週末，公車從 7:00 開始每 20 分鐘一班：7:00、7:20、7:40……。Amy 7:10 到站，下一班是 7:20。車程 40 分鐘，7:20 + 40 分鐘 = 8:00，所以她 8:00 a.m. 到動物園。
hints: 星期六要看平日還是週末的時刻？
週末的公車幾點開始、多久一班？7:10 之後的下一班是幾點？
搭上車以後還要再坐多久？

wrong.D: 以為 7:10 剛好有車，直接加 40 分鐘；但週末的車是 7:00、7:20……，7:10 沒有車。
wrong.B: 用了平日每 30 分鐘一班的時刻（7:30），但今天是星期六。
wrong.A: 只算到搭上 7:20 的車再加 20 分鐘，把車程 40 分鐘看錯了。

stem:
Every Sunday, my parents and I (1)＿＿＿ breakfast at home. Dad makes eggs, and Mom makes tea. But last Sunday was different. We (2)＿＿＿ to a new restaurant near the station, and we ate sandwiches there. The food was good, but it was a little expensive.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) Every Sunday 表示平常的習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 my parents and I 是複數，用 have。(2) But last Sunday was different. 說明上星期天和平常不同，是過去的事，go 的過去式是 went；後面的 ate 也是過去式。
hints: (1) 和 (2) 各有什麼時間詞？
Every Sunday 說的是習慣還是過去某一天？
go 的過去式是什麼？

wrong.D: (1) 有 Every Sunday，說的是每週的習慣，要用現在簡單式，後一句 Dad makes eggs 也是現在式。
wrong.A: (2) 有 last Sunday，是過去發生的事，要用過去式 went。
wrong.B: 兩格的時態都弄反了：習慣用現在式，上星期天的事用過去式。

stem:
Lily: (1)＿＿＿ you at Mark's birthday party last night? I didn't see you there.
Joe: No. I (2)＿＿＿ go. I had a fever, so I stayed in bed all night.
Lily: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Are you OK now?
Joe: Yes, I'm fine today. Thanks.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) Were you at the party? 問「你昨晚在不在派對上」，句中沒有一般動詞，用 be 動詞；last night 是過去，主詞 you 用 Were。(2) 空格後面是原形動詞 go，一般動詞的過去式否定是 didn't + 原形：I didn't go.
hints: (1) 句子裡有一般動詞嗎？「在某地」要用哪一種動詞？
you 的 be 動詞過去式是什麼？
(2) 空格後面的 go 是什麼動詞？否定要借什麼？

wrong.A: (1) 句中沒有一般動詞（at the party 是「在」派對），要用 be 動詞發問。
wrong.C: (2) 後面接的是一般動詞 go，否定要用 didn't，不能用 be 動詞。
wrong.B: 主詞 you 的 be 動詞過去式是 were，不是 was。

stem:
Yesterday morning, Jack (1)＿＿＿ his bike to school as usual. On the way, a dog suddenly ran into the street, and Jack (2)＿＿＿ off his bike. He hurt his leg, so his teacher took him to the nurse's office. Luckily, it wasn't serious.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: Yesterday morning 是過去時間，兩格都要用過去式。ride（騎）是不規則動詞，過去式是 rode；fall（跌落）也是不規則動詞，過去式是 fell，fall off one's bike 是「從腳踏車上摔下來」。
hints: 文章第一個時間詞是什麼？
ride 和 fall 是規則動詞還是不規則動詞？
它們的過去式分別怎麼寫？

wrong.C: ride 是不規則動詞，過去式是 rode，不是加 d。
wrong.B: fall 是不規則動詞，過去式是 fell，不是加 ed。
wrong.D: Yesterday morning 是過去時間，要用過去式，文中的 ran、hurt、took 也都是過去式。

stem:
Read Tom's diary.
Monday, June 3
This morning I woke up late. I ran to the bus stop, but I didn't catch the bus. So Mom drived me to school. At lunch, I bought a sandwich and ate it with my friends. In the afternoon, I felt tired, but I was happy because we won the basketball game.

Which verb in the diary is NOT correct?
explanation: drive（開車）是不規則動詞，過去式是 drove，不能加 d 寫成 drived。woke（wake）、bought（buy）、felt（feel）都是正確的不規則動詞過去式。另外 didn't catch 的 catch 在 didn't 後面用原形，也是正確的。
hints: 日記寫的是過去的事，每個動詞都應該是過去式。
逐一想出每個選項的原形動詞。
drive、wake、buy、feel 哪一個的過去式不是這樣寫？

wrong.A: wake 的過去式就是 woke，是正確的。
wrong.B: buy 的過去式就是 bought，是正確的。
wrong.C: feel 的過去式就是 felt，是正確的。

stem:
Last Saturday was a busy day for Mia. After lunch, she went to the bookstore and bought a birthday card for her friend Rose. Before that, she cleaned her room and washed her clothes in the morning. In the evening, she went to Rose's birthday party and gave her the card. Rose loved it.

What is the right order of the things Mia did?
options: bought a card → cleaned her room → went to a party
cleaned her room → went to a party → bought a card
went to a party → bought a card → cleaned her room
cleaned her room → bought a card → went to a party
explanation: 文中的時間線索：in the morning 打掃房間、洗衣服；After lunch 去書店買卡片；In the evening 去派對。Before that 指「在買卡片之前」，所以順序是：打掃房間 → 買卡片 → 去派對。
hints: 文章的敘述順序就是事情發生的順序嗎？
Before that 的 that 指的是哪件事？
把 in the morning、after lunch、in the evening 對應的事情排好。

wrong.A: 照文章出現的先後排列，沒注意 Before that（在那之前）表示打掃是更早的事。
wrong.C: 把整個順序顛倒了；派對是在晚上。
wrong.B: 卡片是在派對上送給 Rose 的，一定是先買卡片再去派對。

stem:
Ben: How was your trip to Hualien, Amy?
Amy: Not so good. It rained for the first three days, so we stayed in the hotel most of the time.
Ben: Oh, no! Did you go to Taroko?
Amy: Yes, but only on the last day. The sun finally came out that day, and we took a lot of pictures there.
Ben: Well, at least you saw Taroko.

Which is TRUE about Amy's trip?
options: She didn't take any pictures in Hualien.
It rained every day during the trip.
She enjoyed every day of the trip.
She visited Taroko when the weather was good.
explanation: Amy 說只有最後一天去了太魯閣，而且 The sun finally came out that day（那天終於出太陽），所以她是在天氣好的時候去太魯閣。前三天下雨，所以不是每天都下雨，她也不是每天都玩得開心。
hints: Amy 覺得這趟旅行怎麼樣？
雨下了幾天？最後一天天氣如何？
她哪一天去太魯閣？那天她做了什麼？

wrong.C: Amy 一開始就說 Not so good，前三天下雨只能待在飯店。
wrong.B: 只有前三天下雨，最後一天出太陽了。
wrong.A: 她說在太魯閣 took a lot of pictures（拍了很多照片）。

stem:
Dad: Look at the sky! It's so dark.
Amy: Yes, and the wind is getting strong. It (1)＿＿＿ rain soon.
Dad: Then we (2)＿＿＿ take our umbrellas with us. I don't want to get wet.
Amy: OK. I'll get them. They're next to the door.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 天色很暗、風變大，根據眼前跡象判斷「快要下雨」，用 be going to + 原形：It is going to rain soon.。(2) 爸爸不想淋濕，所以建議「應該帶傘」，給建議用 should + 原形。
hints: (1) 說話者根據什麼判斷天氣？soon 表示什麼時候？
be going to 的三個部分是什麼？
爸爸說不想淋濕，他會建議帶傘還是不帶？

wrong.A: be going to 表示未來時三個部分缺一不可，少了 to。
wrong.C: 爸爸說不想淋濕，「不應該帶傘」前後矛盾。
wrong.B: goes to 是「去到某地」，不能表示「即將下雨」。

stem:
Ken: Are you free tomorrow, Rose? Let's go to the movies.
Rose: Sorry, I can't. I (1)＿＿＿ my grandparents in Tainan tomorrow. I (2)＿＿＿ the train ticket last week.
Ken: That's OK. Have a good time there!
Rose: Thanks. Maybe we can go next weekend.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
options: am going to visit; will buy
explanation: (1) tomorrow 是未來，而且是已經計畫好的事，用 be going to + 原形：I am going to visit。(2) last week 是過去，車票上週已經買了，用過去式 bought（buy 的過去式）。
hints: (1) 和 (2) 的時間詞分別是什麼？
明天要做的事用什麼時態？上週做的事呢？
be going to 需要哪三個部分？

wrong.A: (1) 有 tomorrow，是未來的事，不能用過去式。
wrong.D: (2) 有 last week，車票是上週已經買好的，要用過去式。
wrong.C: be going to 少了 be 動詞 am。

stem:
Swimming Pool Rules
- You must take a shower before you swim.
- You must wear a swimming cap.
- Children under 10 must swim with an adult.
- You don't have to bring a towel. We have towels for you.
- You can't eat in the pool area.

Ted is 12 years old. He wants to swim here. What must he do?
options: Eat his lunch in the pool area
explanation: 規則第一條 You must take a shower before you swim.，所有人游泳前都必須淋浴。毛巾是 don't have to（不必）帶；和大人一起游只限 10 歲以下；泳池區 can't（不可以）吃東西。
hints: 題目問的是 Ted「必須」做的事，要找 must 的規則。
Ted 12 歲，哪一條 must 的規則不適用於他？
don't have to 和 can't 分別是什麼意思？

wrong.C: 規則說 You don't have to bring a towel，是「不必」帶，游泳池有提供。
wrong.D: 只有 10 歲以下的小孩必須和大人一起游，Ted 已經 12 歲。
wrong.A: 規則說 You can't eat in the pool area，是禁止的事。

stem:
Visitor: Excuse me. Is the museum still open?
Clerk: Yes, it is. You can look at the paintings, but you (1)＿＿＿ touch them. They are very old.
Visitor: I see. How much is a ticket for my son? He's five.
Clerk: Oh, you (2)＿＿＿ buy a ticket for him. Children under six get in free.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 畫作很古老，可以看但「不可以」摸，表示禁止用 mustn't。(2) Children under six get in free.（六歲以下免費），兒子五歲，所以「不必」買票，用 don't have to。注意 mustn't 是禁止，don't have to 是不必。
hints: (1) 畫很古老，參觀者可以摸嗎？
(2) 兒子幾歲？幾歲以下可以免費入場？
「禁止」和「不必」在英文裡分別怎麼說？

wrong.C: 把兩格弄反了：古畫「禁止」觸摸用 mustn't；小孩免費是「不必」買票，用 don't have to。
wrong.B: 畫很古老，「必須摸」不合理；小孩免費也不需要買票。
wrong.A: 店員說六歲以下免費入場，「必須買票」前後矛盾。

stem:
Hi Jason,
Next Saturday is Grandpa's 70th birthday. We're going to have a party at his house. Mom will make a big cake, and Dad will cook Grandpa's favorite fish. Can you come at 5:00 and help me put up the balloons? The party will start at 6:30. Don't tell Grandpa about it! It's a surprise.
Kelly

Which is TRUE?
options: Kelly wants Jason to come before the party starts.
The party will be at Kelly's house.
Kelly's dad will make the birthday cake.
explanation: Kelly 請 Jason 5:00 來幫忙掛氣球，而派對 6:30 才開始，所以她希望 Jason 在派對開始前就到。爺爺不知道派對（這是驚喜）、蛋糕由媽媽做、派對在爺爺家。
hints: Kelly 請 Jason 幾點來？派對幾點開始？
at his house 的 his 指誰？
誰做蛋糕？誰煮魚？

wrong.B: Kelly 說 Don't tell Grandpa... It's a surprise.，這是給爺爺的驚喜，爺爺不知道。
wrong.D: 做蛋糕的是媽媽，爸爸負責煮魚。
wrong.C: 派對在爺爺家（at his house）舉行。

stem:
Weather report for this weekend:
Saturday: sunny and hot, 32°C
Sunday: heavy rain all day, 21°C

Tina: Let's go to the beach this weekend!
Ray: Good idea. But we should go on the sunny day.
Tina: Right. It will be very hot, so we must bring something for our heads.

When will they probably go to the beach, and what will they bring?
explanation: Ray 說 we should go on the sunny day，氣象報告中晴天是星期六；Tina 說天氣會很熱，must bring something for our heads（必須帶戴在頭上的東西），最合理的是帽子。所以他們會在星期六帶帽子去海邊。
hints: 哪一天是晴天？
Tina 說要帶「給頭用的東西」，是哪一種物品？
天氣 32°C 時需要外套嗎？

wrong.B: 星期天整天大雨，Ray 說要在晴天去。
wrong.D: 星期六 32°C 很熱，不需要外套，而且 Tina 說要帶的是戴在頭上的東西。
wrong.C: 星期天下大雨，不是晴天。

stem:
Amy had a lot of homework last night. She started her science report at seven. She finished (1)＿＿＿ it at ten, and she felt very tired. Then she decided (2)＿＿＿ a short walk in the park near her home before going to bed.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) finish（完成）後面接動名詞：finished writing it。(2) decide（決定）後面接不定詞：decided to take a short walk。句末的 before going to bed 也是介系詞 before 後面接 V-ing。
hints: finish 後面的動詞要用什麼形式？
decide 和 want、hope 是同一類動詞嗎？
這兩個動詞一個接 V-ing，一個接 to V。

wrong.D: 把兩個動詞的用法弄反了：finish 接 V-ing，decide 接 to V。
wrong.A: decide 後面要接不定詞 to V，不接 V-ing。
wrong.B: finish 後面要接動名詞 V-ing，不接不定詞。

stem:
Do you want to learn new English words? Here's a fun way. (1)＿＿＿ English songs is a good way to learn new words. My brother is good at (2)＿＿＿ them, and he learns five or six new words from every song. He also enjoys watching English cartoons.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 空格在句首，是句子的主詞（動詞是 is），動詞當主詞要改成動名詞 Singing。(2) be good at（擅長）的 at 是介系詞，介系詞後面接動名詞：good at singing them。
hints: (1) 這句話的主要動詞是什麼？空格是在當主詞嗎？
(2) 空格前面的 at 是什麼詞性？
動詞要當主詞或放在介系詞後面時，要怎麼改？

wrong.C: 原形動詞不能當主詞；介系詞 at 後面也不能接原形動詞。
wrong.A: be good at 的 at 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing，不接 to V。
wrong.D: Sings 是動詞，不能當句子的主詞。

stem:
Mia: Can you help me with this math problem? It's too hard for me.
Dan: Sure. Let me see... Oh, it's not difficult (1)＿＿＿ this problem. I can teach you (2)＿＿＿ do it.
Mia: Thank you! You're so good at math. I hope to be like you someday.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) It's + 形容詞 + to + 原形動詞 表示「做某事是……的」，It 是虛主詞，真正的主詞是 to solve this problem。(2) teach someone how to + 原形 表示「教某人如何做」，how to do it 就是「怎麼做這題」。
hints: (1) 句子 it's not difficult ＿ this problem 中，It 代替的是什麼？
(2)「教你怎麼做」要用哪個疑問詞 + 不定詞？
what to do 和 how to do 後面可以再接 it 嗎？

wrong.C: teach you how 後面直接接原形 do 不合文法，要用 how to + 原形。
wrong.B: what to do 已經有 do 的受詞 what，後面再加 it 就重複了。
wrong.D: It's + 形容詞 + to V 的句型，不能省略 to。

stem:
Kevin was late for school three times last week. This morning, he was late again. His teacher, Ms. Lin, was not happy. She told him (1)＿＿＿ late again, and she wants everyone in the class (2)＿＿＿ at school before 7:30 every day.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) tell + 人 + to V 表示「叫某人做某事」，否定是 tell + 人 + not to V，所以是 told him not to be late again。(2) want + 人 + to V 表示「要某人做某事」，所以是 wants everyone to arrive。
hints: tell someone 和 want someone 後面的動詞要用什麼形式？
不定詞的否定，not 要放在 to 的前面還是後面？
(1) 老師是叫 Kevin 做什麼還是不要做什麼？

wrong.A: tell someone 後面接不定詞 to + 原形，不能接 being；want someone 後面也要接 to V。
wrong.D: tell someone 後面不能直接接祈使句 don't be；want someone 後面要加 to。
wrong.C: tell someone 後面要接不定詞，否定是 not to + 原形，不是 not being。

stem:
Many students spend hours playing computer games every day. Some parents think playing games is a waste of time, but games are not always bad. Some games teach players to work with others, and some help them practice thinking fast. The real problem is not playing games, but playing too long. Students should learn to stop after an hour and save time for homework, sports, and sleep.

What is the writer's main point?
options: Students should never play computer games.
Playing games is OK if students don't play too long.
Students should stop doing homework to play games.
Parents should play games with their children.
explanation: 作者先說遊戲不一定是壞事，並舉例：可以學習合作、練習快速思考；接著點出重點 The real problem is not playing games, but playing too long.（真正的問題不是玩遊戲，而是玩太久），最後建議玩一小時就要停下來。所以主旨是：只要不玩太久，玩遊戲是可以的。
hints: 作者對玩電腦遊戲的態度是完全反對嗎？
找出 The real problem is not..., but... 這一句。
最後一句的建議和哪個選項的意思最接近？

wrong.A: 作者說 games are not always bad，還舉出遊戲的好處，並不反對玩遊戲。
wrong.D: 文中沒有提到父母要陪孩子玩遊戲。
wrong.C: 作者剛好相反，要學生留時間給功課、運動和睡眠。

stem:
Dear neighbors,
Do you have books that you don't read anymore? Please don't throw them away! Bring them to the community center before May 20. We are planning to send them to children in the mountains. We also need some people to help pack the books on May 21. If you'd like to help, please call Ms. Lee at 2345-6789.

What is the purpose of this letter?
options: To sell old books at the community center
To invite children to a party in the mountains
To tell people where to buy new books
To ask people to give old books and help pack them
explanation: 信一開頭問大家有沒有不再讀的書，請大家不要丟掉，在 5 月 20 日前送到社區中心，要送給山區的孩子；還徵求 5 月 21 日幫忙打包的人。所以寫信的目的是請鄰居捐出舊書並幫忙打包。
hints: 這封信是寫給誰的？請他們做哪些事？
書最後要送去哪裡？
Ms. Lee 的電話是給什麼人打的？

wrong.A: 信中是請大家「捐」書給山區的孩子，不是要賣書。
wrong.B: 書是要送給山區的孩子，信中沒有提到派對。
wrong.C: 信中談的是不再讀的舊書，不是買新書。

stem:
Ted wants to buy a new phone. Here are three phones in the store:
Phone A: NT$8,000, 150 grams
Phone B: NT$12,000, 180 grams
Phone C: NT$10,000, 130 grams
Ted doesn't have much money, but he also wants a light phone.

Which is TRUE about the three phones?
options: Phone B is cheaper than Phone C.
Phone A is heavier than Phone C.
Phone A is lighter than Phone C.
Phone C is the most expensive.
explanation: 比較重量：Phone A 150 公克，Phone C 130 公克，150 > 130，所以 Phone A 比 Phone C 重（heavier）。價格由高到低是 B（12,000）> C（10,000）> A（8,000），所以 B 不比 C 便宜，C 也不是最貴的。
hints: 先把三支手機的價格和重量分別排順序。
公克數越大表示越重還是越輕？
cheaper、heavier、lighter、the most expensive 分別是什麼意思？

wrong.A: Phone B 要 NT$12,000，比 Phone C 的 NT$10,000 貴。
wrong.D: 最貴的是 Phone B（NT$12,000），Phone C 排第二。
wrong.C: Phone A 150 公克，Phone C 130 公克，A 比較重，把輕重弄反了。

stem:
Kevin and I walk to school together every day. Kevin's bag is heavy, but my bag is even (1)＿＿＿. There are five books in my bag, and there are only three in his. So my bag is (2)＿＿＿ of the two. I think I should take some books out.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) even 用來加強比較級，表示「甚至更……」，heavy 字尾是「子音 + y」，比較級是 heavier。(2) of the two 是在兩者之中比較，要用 the + 比較級：the heavier of the two（兩個之中較重的）。
hints: even 後面要接原級、比較級還是最高級？
heavy 字尾是 y，變比較級時怎麼改？
of the two 是幾個東西在比較？前面要不要加 the？

wrong.C: heavy 的比較級是 heavier，不是 more heavy；而且只有兩個書包。
wrong.D: 「兩者之中較……的那一個」要用 the + 比較級，不能少了 the。
wrong.A: even（更加）要修飾比較級，不能接最高級。

stem:
Four students are in a class photo. Cathy is the tallest of the four, and she is 170 cm. Amy is the shortest; she is 150 cm. Dan is 162 cm. Ben is taller than Dan, but he isn't as tall as Cathy.

How tall could Ben be?
explanation: Ben is taller than Dan，所以 Ben 超過 162 公分；he isn't as tall as Cathy，而且 Cathy 是 the tallest of the four，所以 Ben 不到 170 公分。只有 168 公分在 162 和 170 之間。
hints: Ben 和 Dan 比，誰比較高？
isn't as tall as Cathy 是什麼意思？
Ben 的身高要在哪兩個數字之間？

wrong.B: 160 公分比 Dan 的 162 公分矮，但文中說 Ben 比 Dan 高。
wrong.C: 172 公分比 Cathy 還高，但 Cathy 是四個人中最高的。
wrong.D: 148 公分比 Amy 還矮，但 Amy 是四個人中最矮的。

stem:
Ann: What's your favorite season, Joe?
Joe: Of all the seasons, I like summer (1)＿＿＿ because I love swimming in the sea.
Ann: My sister is different. She likes winter (2)＿＿＿ than summer because she hates hot weather.
Joe: Really? I think winter is too cold!

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: like 的程度用副詞 well 表示，比較級是 better，最高級是 best。(1) Of all the seasons（在所有季節中）是三者以上的比較，用最高級：like summer best。(2) 後面有 than summer，是兩者比較，用比較級：likes winter better than summer。
hints: (1) Of all the seasons 是在幾個季節裡比較？
(2) 空格後面出現了哪個字？
「最喜歡」和「比較喜歡」英文分別怎麼說？

wrong.B: 把兩格弄反了：Of all the seasons 是在所有季節中比較，用最高級；有 than 才用比較級。
wrong.D: Of all the seasons 要用最高級；而且 good 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 like。
wrong.C: (2) 後面有 than，要用比較級 better。

stem:
Last week, Mr. Lin gave his class a math test. Tom got 85 points. Mia got the same score as Tom. Joe got 5 points more than Mia, and he was very happy about it. Mr. Lin said all three of them did a good job.

Which is TRUE?
options: Mia's score was as high as Tom's.
Tom's score was not as high as Mia's.
Mia's score was higher than Joe's.
Joe's score was as high as Mia's.
explanation: Tom 85 分，Mia got the same score as Tom，也是 85 分；Joe 比 Mia 多 5 分，是 90 分。兩人分數相同用 as + 原級 + as，所以 Mia's score was as high as Tom's. 正確。
hints: 先算出三個人各考幾分。
the same score as 是什麼意思？
as high as 和 not as high as 分別表示什麼關係？

wrong.B: Mia 和 Tom 分數相同，不能說 Tom 沒有 Mia 高。
wrong.D: Joe 比 Mia 多 5 分，兩人分數不一樣。
wrong.C: Joe 比 Mia 多 5 分，是 Joe 的分數比較高。

stem:
Last month, my family moved to a new house. The new house is not as big as our old one, and it doesn't have a garden. But I like it more because it is closer to my school. Now I can walk to school in five minutes. Before, I took the bus for thirty minutes every day.

Which is TRUE about the new house?
options: It is as far from school as the old house.
It is smaller than the old house.
It has a bigger garden than the old house.
It is bigger than the old house.
explanation: The new house is not as big as our old one. 表示新房子沒有舊房子大，也就是新房子比較小（smaller）。新家比較靠近學校，而且沒有花園。
hints: not as big as 是「一樣大」還是「沒那麼大」？
新家離學校近還是遠？
新房子有花園嗎？

wrong.D: not as big as 是「沒有那麼大」，新房子比較小。
wrong.A: 新家比較靠近學校，走路五分鐘；以前要搭三十分鐘公車。
wrong.C: 文中說新房子 doesn't have a garden（沒有花園）。

stem:
Sam saw a pair of cool shoes in a store last month. He wanted to buy them, (1)＿＿＿ he didn't have enough money. (2)＿＿＿ he saved his pocket money for two months, he finally bought them last Sunday. Now he wears them every day.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 想買鞋子，但是錢不夠，前後語意相反，用 but。(2) 存了兩個月的零用錢「之後」，終於買到鞋子，表示事情的先後順序，用 After；finally（終於）也提示存錢在先、買鞋在後。
hints: (1) 「想買」和「錢不夠」是什麼關係？
(2) 存錢和買到鞋子，哪件事先發生？
finally 這個字給了你什麼線索？

wrong.C: so 表示結果，「想買所以錢不夠」不合理；想買和錢不夠是轉折關係。
wrong.B: 存了兩個月的錢，終於買到鞋子，是順理成章的事，不是相反關係。
wrong.A: or 表示「或者」不合句意；而且「存錢之前就終於買到」不合理。

stem:
Mom: What are we going to do this weekend?
Dad: Let's go hiking on Sunday morning. But the weather report says it may rain.
Mom: Then here's our plan. If it (1)＿＿＿ on Sunday, we (2)＿＿＿ at home and watch movies.
Kids: Great! We love movies.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: 這是對星期天的假設計畫。if 引導的條件子句用現在簡單式表示未來：If it rains on Sunday；主要子句用未來式：we will stay at home。主詞 it 是第三人稱單數，所以 rain 要加 s。
hints: 這個計畫是過去還是未來的事？
if 子句裡可以用 will 嗎？
主要子句要用什麼時態表示未來？

wrong.A: if 引導的條件子句要用現在式表示未來，不能用 will rain。
wrong.C: 星期天是未來的事，條件子句不能用過去式 rained。
wrong.D: 主要子句說的是未來的計畫，要用 will stay，不能用過去式。

stem:
Ella: Your brother can speak Japanese, (1)＿＿＿?
Ken: (2)＿＿＿ He only speaks Chinese and English. But he wants to learn Japanese next year.
Ella: Oh, I see. My aunt teaches Japanese. Maybe she can help him.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 前句是肯定句，用助動詞 can，附加問句用否定的 can't，主詞 Your brother 換成 he：can't he。(2) Ken 說 He only speaks Chinese and English.（只會說中文和英文），所以哥哥不會日文，要回答 No, he can't.。
hints: (1) 前句用的是哪個助動詞？是肯定還是否定？
Ken 的哥哥會說哪些語言？
回答附加問句時，只看事實決定用 Yes 還是 No。

wrong.B: 附加問句要「前肯後否」，前句是肯定的 can speak，附加問句要用否定 can't he。
wrong.D: Ken 說哥哥只會說中文和英文，所以他不會日文，不能回答 Yes。
wrong.A: 前句用助動詞 can，附加問句和回答都要用 can，不能改用 does。

stem:
Amy: Mr. and Mrs. Chen live next to you, (1)＿＿＿?
Ben: (2)＿＿＿ They moved to Taichung last month. A new family lives there now.
Amy: Oh, I didn't know that. I wanted to give this book back to Mrs. Chen.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 前句是肯定的現在簡單式，動詞 live 是一般動詞，主詞 Mr. and Mrs. Chen 是複數，附加問句用 don't they。(2) 他們上個月搬到台中，現在住在隔壁的是新的一家人，所以事實是「沒有住在隔壁」，回答 No, they don't.。
hints: (1) 前句的動詞是 be 動詞還是一般動詞？主詞有幾個人？
陳先生夫婦現在還住在 Ben 隔壁嗎？
事實是否定時，回答要用 Yes 還是 No？

wrong.A: 前句的動詞 live 是一般動詞，附加問句要用助動詞 don't，不能用 be 動詞。
wrong.D: 陳先生夫婦上個月已經搬到台中，現在不住在 Ben 隔壁，不能回答 Yes。
wrong.C: 主詞 Mr. and Mrs. Chen 是兩個人，要用 they 和 don't。

stem:
Ryan and his twin brother, Sean, look the same, but they have very different habits. Ryan gets up early, while Sean always stays up late and gets up at the last minute. Ryan walks to school because he likes exercise. Sean takes the bus, so he can sleep a little longer. However, they both enjoy cooking, and they often make dinner together when their parents work late.

Which is TRUE?
options: Sean walks to school to get exercise.
Ryan gets up later than Sean.
Sean takes the bus because he doesn't like walking.
explanation: 前面用 but、while 說明兄弟倆習慣不同，接著用 However 轉折：they both enjoy cooking（他們都喜歡做菜），還常常一起煮晚餐。所以「雙胞胎都喜歡做菜」正確。
hints: 文中哪一個連接詞把「不同」轉到「相同」？
Ryan 和 Sean 誰早起？誰走路上學？
Sean 搭公車的原因，文中用哪個連接詞說明？

wrong.A: 走路上學、喜歡運動的是 Ryan，Sean 搭公車。
wrong.B: Ryan 早起，Sean 總是最後一刻才起床，是 Sean 起得比較晚。
wrong.C: Sean 搭公車是為了可以多睡一點（so he can sleep a little longer），文中沒說他不喜歡走路。

stem:
Sports Day Notice
- Sports Day is on Friday, October 20. If it rains that day, it will be moved to the next Monday.
- Students must wear sports clothes, or they can't join the games.
- Lunch is free for students, but parents need to pay NT$100 for lunch.
- Please arrive before 7:40 because the opening starts at 8:00.

Kevin's mom wants to have lunch with Kevin on Sports Day. On Friday, October 20, it rains hard all day. What should she do?
options: Come on Monday and pay NT$100 for lunch
Come on Friday and pay nothing for lunch
Come on Friday and pay NT$100 for lunch
Come on Monday and pay nothing for lunch
explanation: 通知第一條：If it rains that day, it will be moved to the next Monday.，星期五下大雨，運動會改到下星期一。第三條：Lunch is free for students, but parents need to pay NT$100.，媽媽是家長，要付 100 元。所以她應該星期一來，並付 100 元午餐費。
hints: 星期五下雨的話，運動會會怎麼樣？
午餐對學生和家長的規定有什麼不同？
這題要同時用到通知中的兩條規定。

wrong.B: 星期五下雨，運動會會延到下星期一；而且只有學生免費，家長要付錢。
wrong.D: 日子對了，但通知說 parents need to pay NT$100，家長的午餐要付 100 元。
wrong.C: 星期五下大雨，運動會改到下星期一，星期五不會舉行。

stem:
Judy: Your photos are beautiful! (1)＿＿＿ to Japan?
Leo: Yes. I (2)＿＿＿ there with my family two years ago. We visited Tokyo and Kyoto.
Judy: Lucky you! I've never been there. I hope to go someday.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
options: Have you ever been; have been
explanation: (1) 問對方「曾經去過」日本嗎，用現在完成式 Have you ever been to...?。(2) two years ago 是明確的過去時間，要用過去簡單式 went；現在完成式不能和 ago、last year 這類明確的過去時間連用。
hints: (1) Judy 想問的是「曾經」去過嗎？要用什麼時態？
(2) 的句子裡有什麼時間詞？
現在完成式可以和 two years ago 一起用嗎？

wrong.B: (2) 有 two years ago，是明確的過去時間，不能用現在完成式。
wrong.C: Did 後面要接原形動詞，不能接過去分詞 been。
wrong.A: have 後面要接過去分詞 been 或 gone，went 是過去式。

stem:
Mom: Is your sister home, Tom?
Tom: No, she (1)＿＿＿ to the supermarket. She'll be back in ten minutes.
Mom: OK. Have you finished your homework (2)＿＿＿?
Tom: Not yet. I'm still working on my English report.
Mom: Please finish it before dinner.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 姊姊（妹妹）不在家，十分鐘後才回來，表示她「已經去了超市、人還在那裡」，用 has gone to。(2) 現在完成式的疑問句問「已經……了嗎」，句尾用 yet；Tom 回答 Not yet 也可以印證。
hints: (1) 姊姊（妹妹）現在在家嗎？
have gone to 和 have been to 的差別是什麼？
Tom 回答 Not yet，問句句尾應該用哪個字？

wrong.B: has been to 表示「曾經去過、已經回來」，但姊姊（妹妹）現在不在家。
wrong.A: ago 要接在一段時間後面，而且不能用在現在完成式的問句裡。
wrong.C: since 後面要接時間起點；而且 has been to 不合「人還沒回來」的情境。

stem:
My parents bought their car in 2018, and they still drive it today. The car is old, but it still runs well. Dad washes it every weekend, and Mom says it's like a member of our family. It's 2026 now, so my parents (1)＿＿＿ the car (2)＿＿＿.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: 車子 2018 年買的，到 2026 年仍在使用，表示「從過去持續到現在」，用現在完成式。買（buy）是瞬間動作不能持續，要用表示擁有的 have，過去分詞是 had：have had。2018 到 2026 年是一段時間八年，用 for eight years（也可以說 since 2018，但要搭配 have had）。
hints: 從 2018 年到 2026 年，一共是幾年？
「買」這個動作可以持續八年嗎？哪個動詞表示「擁有」？
for 和 since 後面分別接什麼？

wrong.D: buy 是一瞬間就完成的動作，不能持續八年；要表示「擁有」八年，用 have had。
wrong.A: since 後面要接時間起點（例如 since 2018），eight years 是一段時間，要用 for。
wrong.C: since 表示「從那時到現在」，要搭配現在完成式，不能用過去式 had。

stem:
Mr. Wu came to Tainan in 2010. At first, he worked in a bookstore for four years. Then he became a teacher, and he has taught at Sunny Junior High School since then. He loves his job, and his students love him, too.

It is 2026 now. How long has Mr. Wu taught at Sunny Junior High School?
explanation: 吳老師 2010 年到台南，先在書店工作四年，所以 2014 年才開始在 Sunny 國中教書（since then 指書店工作結束之後）。2014 年到 2026 年是 12 年，所以他已經教了十二年（for twelve years）。
hints: 吳老師來台南後先做什麼工作？做了幾年？
since then 的 then 指的是哪一年？
從那一年到 2026 年是幾年？

wrong.A: 從 2010 年算起，但他前四年在書店工作，不是在學校教書。
wrong.B: 四年是他在書店工作的時間。
wrong.D: 2010 年是他來台南的年份，那時他還在書店工作，不是開始教書的時間。

stem:
Dear Grandma,
We have lived in our new apartment for a month now. I like it here. I have already made two new friends, Lisa and Joy. They live on the fifth floor. I have also joined the school band, but I haven't found a piano teacher yet. Mom has looked for one on the Internet. For now, I practice on the old piano in the living room.
Love,
Amy

What has Amy NOT done yet?
explanation: 信中說 I haven't found a piano teacher yet.（我還沒找到鋼琴老師），haven't... yet 表示「還沒」。交新朋友、加入樂隊、搬新家都是已經完成的事（have already made、have joined、have lived）。
hints: 題目問的是 Amy「還沒」做的事。
信中哪一句用了 haven't... yet？
already 和 yet 分別用在什麼樣的句子？

wrong.C: Amy 說 I have already made two new friends，她已經交到新朋友了。
wrong.A: Amy 說 I have also joined the school band，她已經加入樂隊了。
wrong.B: 信的第一句就說他們已經在新公寓住了一個月。

stem:
Ken: Mom, have you seen my glasses? I've looked everywhere in my room.
Mom: Have you checked your schoolbag?
Ken: Yes, I've already checked it twice. They're not there.
Mom: What about the bathroom? You took a shower an hour ago.
Ken: Oh! I haven't looked there yet. I'll go and check.

Where will Ken probably look for his glasses next?
explanation: Ken 已經找遍房間、書包也找了兩次。媽媽提醒他一小時前洗過澡，Ken 說 I haven't looked there yet.（我還沒找那裡），there 指浴室，而且他說要去看看，所以他接下來最可能去浴室找。
hints: Ken 已經找過哪些地方？
I haven't looked there yet. 的 there 指哪裡？
還沒找過的地方，就是他接下來要去的地方。

wrong.C: Ken 說書包已經找過兩次了（already checked it twice）。
wrong.D: Ken 一開始就說已經找遍了房間（looked everywhere in my room）。
wrong.A: 對話中完全沒有提到廚房。

stem:
Look at this beautiful cake! It (1)＿＿＿ by my sister. She (2)＿＿＿ it for Mom's birthday yesterday. It has strawberries on top, and it tastes great. Mom was so happy that she took a picture of it before we ate it.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 主詞 It（蛋糕）是被做出來的，後面又有 by my sister，要用被動語態；昨天做的，用過去式被動 was made。(2) 主詞 She 是動作的執行者，後面接受詞 it，用主動語態的過去式 made。
hints: (1) 蛋糕是做的人還是被做的東西？
(2) 的主詞 She 是做動作的人嗎？後面有沒有受詞？
yesterday 提示兩格要用什麼時態？

wrong.C: 把兩格弄反了：蛋糕是「被做」的要用被動；姊姊（妹妹）是做蛋糕的人要用主動。
wrong.B: (2) 的主詞 She 是做蛋糕的人，要用主動語態，而且後面有受詞 it。
wrong.D: 蛋糕昨天做好的，(1) 要用過去式；(2) 的 She 是做動作的人，不能用被動。

stem:
The new park near my home opened last year. Many trees (1)＿＿＿ there before it opened, and now the park is green and beautiful. People (2)＿＿＿ there every evening, and children play on the grass. It has become my favorite place in town.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 樹不會自己種，是「被種植」，要用被動；開幕前種的，用過去式被動 were planted（trees 是複數）。(2) People 是自己去散步的人，用主動；every evening 表示現在的習慣，用現在簡單式 walk。
hints: (1) 樹是種的人，還是被種的東西？
(2) People 是做動作的人嗎？
兩格的時間線索分別是什麼？

wrong.B: 樹是被種的，(1) 要用被動；人是自己去散步的，(2) 要用主動。
wrong.C: (2) 的主詞 People 是散步的人，是動作的執行者，要用主動。
wrong.D: 樹是公園開幕前種的，要用過去式；(2) 有 every evening，表示現在的習慣，不能用過去式。

stem:
Music in the Park!
A free concert (1)＿＿＿ in Central Park next Sunday at 7 p.m. You don't need a ticket. Please come early to get a good seat. Drinks can (2)＿＿＿ at the front gate, and food will be sold near the lake. See you there!

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 音樂會是被舉辦的，next Sunday 是未來，未來式被動是 will be + 過去分詞：will be held（hold 的過去分詞是 held）。(2) 飲料是被買的，助動詞 can 後面的被動是 can + be + 過去分詞：can be bought。
hints: (1) 音樂會是舉辦的人，還是被舉辦的活動？next Sunday 是什麼時態？
(2) 飲料是被買的嗎？can 後面要接什麼形式？
未來式和助動詞的被動都是「助動詞 + be + 過去分詞」。

wrong.A: 音樂會是「被舉辦」的，不會自己舉辦東西，要用被動 will be held。
wrong.D: 飲料是「被買」的，can 後面的被動要用 be + 過去分詞。
wrong.C: next Sunday 是未來，不能用現在式；can 後面不能直接接過去分詞。

stem:
The Ocean Museum was opened in 1995. Every year, it is visited by about one million people. Many of the fish in the museum were brought from other countries. Last year, the shark area was damaged by an earthquake, so it was closed. Workers are repairing it now, and it will be opened again next spring.

Which is TRUE?
options: All the fish in the museum were brought from other countries.
The museum was opened last year.
The museum was damaged by an earthquake in 1995.
The shark area will be opened again next spring.
explanation: 文中最後說 Workers are repairing it now, and it will be opened again next spring.，it 指關閉的鯊魚區，未來式被動 will be opened 表示明年春天會重新開放。博物館 1995 年開幕、很多（不是全部）魚來自國外、地震發生在去年。
hints: 文中出現了哪些年份或時間？各發生了什麼事？
最後一句的 it 指什麼？
Many 和 All 的意思一樣嗎？

wrong.B: 博物館 1995 年開幕；去年發生的是鯊魚區被地震損壞。
wrong.A: 文中說 Many of the fish（很多魚），不是全部。
wrong.C: 1995 年是開幕的年份，地震是去年發生的，損壞的是鯊魚區。

stem:
Our school garden was started by the science club three years ago. Now vegetables are grown there by students in every grade. Last month, some of the vegetables were sold at the school fair, and the money was given to a children's hospital. This year, the garden will be made bigger, so more students can join.

What happened to the money from the vegetables?
options: It was used to make the garden bigger.
It was kept by the science club.
It was given to a children's hospital.
It was used to buy new seeds.
explanation: 文中說 some of the vegetables were sold at the school fair, and the money was given to a children's hospital.，賣菜的錢被捐給了兒童醫院。
hints: 找到 money 出現的句子。
the money was given to... 是誰「被給」了錢？
其他選項的內容，文中有說到嗎？

wrong.A: 花園今年會擴大，但文中沒有說是用賣菜的錢。
wrong.B: 自然社是三年前開闢花園的社團，錢並沒有留給他們。
wrong.D: 文中沒有提到買種子。

stem:
Every October, the Moon Lake Kite Festival is held in our town. Kites of all shapes are flown by people from many countries. This year, the biggest kite was made by a group of high school students in our town; it was 20 meters long. Sadly, on the second day, the festival was stopped because of strong winds. The prizes will be given out next week.

Which is TRUE?
options: The biggest kite was made by people from other countries.
The festival is held every spring.
The festival was stopped because of rain.
The winners will get their prizes later.
explanation: 文中最後說 The prizes will be given out next week.（獎品下週才會頒發），所以得獎者之後才會拿到獎品。風箏節在十月、最大的風箏是本地高中生做的、停辦原因是強風。
hints: 風箏節在哪個月舉行？
最大的風箏是誰做的？
最後一句 will be given out next week 說明獎品什麼時候頒發？

wrong.B: 風箏節在每年十月舉行，是秋天，不是春天。
wrong.A: 最大的風箏是本鎮的一群高中生做的。
wrong.C: 風箏節第二天停辦是因為強風（strong winds），不是下雨。

stem:
Look at the boy (1)＿＿＿ is talking to Ms. Lin. He is my cousin, Sam. He just moved here from Taichung. His sister, (2)＿＿＿ name is Amy, is in my class. Amy and I sit next to each other, and we often eat lunch together.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 先行詞 the boy 是人，關係代名詞在子句中當主詞（後面接 is talking），用 who。(2) 先行詞 His sister 是人，空格後面接名詞 name，表示「她的名字叫 Amy」，用所有格關係代名詞 whose。
hints: (1) 先行詞是人還是物？空格後面接的是動詞還是名詞？
(2) 空格後面接了什麼名詞？
表示「……的」的關係代名詞是哪一個？

wrong.B: 先行詞 the boy 是人，(1) 不能用 which。
wrong.A: (2) 空格後面接名詞 name，表示「她的名字」，要用所有格 whose。
wrong.D: (1) 空格後面直接接動詞 is talking，要用主格 who；(2) 的先行詞是人，也不能用 which。

stem:
In this photo, there are four people. The woman who is holding a baby is my aunt. The man who is standing next to her is my uncle; he is a pilot. The baby, whose name is Ella, is their first child. The old man who is sitting in the chair is my grandpa.

Who is Ella?
explanation: The baby, whose name is Ella, is their first child.，their 指前面的 my aunt 和 my uncle，所以 Ella 是作者阿姨（姑姑）和叔叔（姑丈）的第一個孩子，也就是作者的表（堂）妹，英文是 cousin。
hints: whose name is Ella 描述的是照片中的哪一個人？
their first child 的 their 指誰？
阿姨（姑姑）的孩子，要怎麼稱呼？

wrong.A: 作者的阿姨（姑姑）是抱著嬰兒的那位女士，不是 Ella。
wrong.B: Ella 是阿姨（姑姑）和叔叔（姑丈）的孩子，不是作者父母的孩子。
wrong.C: 坐在椅子上的是爺爺，Ella 是嬰兒，不是爺爺的太太。

stem:
I'm very sad today. The bike (1)＿＿＿ my dad gave me last year (2)＿＿＿ stolen yesterday afternoon. I parked it in front of the library, and when I came out, it was gone. I'm going to tell the police about it.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 先行詞 The bike 是物品，在子句中當 gave 的受詞，用 which。(2) 整句的主詞是 The bike（關係子句 which my dad gave me last year 只是修飾它），腳踏車是「被偷」，yesterday 是過去，單數主詞用 was stolen。
hints: (1) 先行詞是人還是物？
去掉關係子句後，整句的主詞是什麼？是單數還是複數？
yesterday afternoon 提示 (2) 要用什麼時態？

wrong.B: 先行詞 The bike 是物品，不能用 who。
wrong.A: 句子的主詞是 The bike（單數），不是 my dad 或 me，be 動詞要用 was。
wrong.C: 空格後面不是接名詞，不能用 whose；而且 yesterday 是過去，要用 was。

stem:
Mr. Lin: Whose books are these? They are on my desk, and I need the desk for my computer.
Ann: The books which (1)＿＿＿ on your desk (2)＿＿＿ to Joe. He left them there this morning.
Mr. Lin: OK. Please tell him to take them back after class.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) which 代替先行詞 The books（複數），關係子句的 be 動詞用 are。(2) 整句的主詞是 The books，which are on your desk 只是修飾語，所以主要動詞用複數 belong（belong to 表示「屬於」）。
hints: which 代替的是哪個名詞？
整句話真正的主詞是什麼？不要被 your desk 騙了。
主詞是複數時，動詞要不要加 s？

wrong.B: which 代替的是 The books（複數），整句的主詞也是 The books，兩格都要用複數。
wrong.C: (2) 的主詞是 The books，不是最靠近的 your desk，動詞不加 s。
wrong.D: (1) which 代替複數的 The books，be 動詞要用 are。

stem:
Help Wanted
We need a person who can speak English and Japanese, who is free on weekends, and who likes working with children. Please call Ms. Ho at 2233-4455.

Who is the best person for this job?
options: Ben, who loves kids and is free on weekends, speaks only English.
Cindy, who speaks English and Japanese and is free on weekends, has taught children for two years.
David, who speaks Japanese and English, doesn't like noisy children.
Amy, who speaks English and Japanese, works at a bank on weekends.
explanation: 徵人條件有三個（三個 who 子句）：會說英文和日文、週末有空、喜歡和小孩一起工作。Cindy 會說英日文、週末有空，而且教過小孩兩年，三個條件都符合。Amy 週末要上班、Ben 不會日文、David 不喜歡小孩。
hints: 徵人廣告用了幾個 who 子句？各是什麼條件？
把每個人的資料和三個條件一一對照。
只有一個人三個條件全部符合。

wrong.D: Amy 週末要在銀行上班，不符合「週末有空」的條件。
wrong.A: Ben 只會說英文，不符合「會說英文和日文」的條件。
wrong.C: David 不喜歡吵鬧的小孩，不符合「喜歡和孩子相處」的條件。

stem:
Guess what animal I am thinking of. It is an animal that lives in the sea, but it isn't a fish. Its babies drink milk from their mothers. It can't stay under the water all the time; it must come up to get air. One kind of this animal is the biggest animal that has ever lived on Earth.

What animal is it?
explanation: 線索：住在海裡但不是魚、寶寶喝母奶、要浮上水面換氣，而且其中一種（藍鯨）是地球上有史以來最大的動物。符合所有條件的是鯨魚（whale）。
hints: 題目給了幾個線索？把每個 that 子句的內容整理出來。
住在海裡卻不是魚，寶寶還喝母奶，是哪一類動物？
地球上最大的動物是什麼？

wrong.A: 鯊魚是魚，但文中說 it isn't a fish。
wrong.B: 大象住在陸地上，但文中說這種動物 lives in the sea。
wrong.C: 海龜的寶寶不喝母奶，而且海龜也不是地球上最大的動物。

stem:
Tourist: Excuse me. Could you tell me (1)＿＿＿?
Clerk: The next one leaves at 3:15.
Tourist: Thank you. And do you know (2)＿＿＿?
Clerk: Sure. You can buy one at the machine over there. It only takes coins.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
options: when does the next bus leave; where I can buy a ticket
when the next bus leaves; where I can buy a ticket
when the next bus leaves; where can I buy a ticket
when the next bus leave; where I buy can a ticket
explanation: 間接問句要用直述句語序：疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞。(1) When does the next bus leave? 去掉 does，主詞 the next bus 是單數，動詞加 s：when the next bus leaves。(2) Where can I buy a ticket? 改成 where I can buy a ticket。
hints: 疑問句放進 Could you tell me / do you know 後面時，語序要怎麼改？
去掉助動詞 does 之後，動詞要不要變化？
間接問句中，主詞要放在助動詞 can 的前面還是後面？

wrong.A: (1) 保留了直接問句的 does 倒裝，間接問句要改成直述句語序。
wrong.C: (2) 保留了直接問句 can I 的倒裝，間接問句要主詞在前：I can。
wrong.D: 去掉 does 後，第三人稱單數的 leave 要加 s；can 也要放在動詞 buy 前面。

stem:
Ms. Wang: Amy, do you know (1)＿＿＿ yesterday? I didn't see him in class.
Amy: No, he didn't. He had a bad cold, so he stayed home.
Ms. Wang: I see. Can you tell me (2)＿＿＿? I want to call his parents.
Amy: Sorry, I don't know his phone number.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
options: if Ken came to school; what is his phone number
did Ken come to school; what his phone number is
if Ken came to school; what his phone number is
where Ken came to school; what his phone number is
explanation: (1) Amy 回答 No, he didn't.，可知原本的問題是 Yes/No 問句 Did Ken come to school yesterday?，變成間接問句要用 if 連接，去掉 did、動詞改成過去式：if Ken came to school。(2) What is his phone number? 改成直述句語序：what his phone number is。
hints: Amy 用 No, he didn't. 回答，原本是哪一種問句？
Yes/No 問句變成間接問句時要加哪個字？
(2) 的主詞是什麼？它要放在 is 的前面還是後面？

wrong.B: (1) 間接問句不能保留 did 倒裝，Yes/No 問句要用 if 連接。
wrong.A: (2) 間接問句要用直述句語序，主詞 his phone number 要放在 is 前面。
wrong.D: Amy 回答 No, he didn't.，表示原本是 Yes/No 問句，要用 if（是否），不是 where。

stem:
A: Good afternoon. What's the problem today?
B: I've had a terrible toothache since last night. I couldn't sleep at all.
A: Let me take a look. Open your mouth, please... Hmm, there's a big hole in this tooth. I'll fix it for you today. After that, don't eat too many sweets, and brush your teeth after every meal.
B: OK. Thank you.

Where does this conversation probably take place?
explanation: B 說牙痛（toothache）睡不著，A 請 B 張開嘴巴檢查，發現牙齒有個洞，說今天幫他補好，並提醒少吃甜食、飯後刷牙。能檢查並治療牙齒的是牙醫，所以對話最可能發生在牙醫診所。
hints: B 哪裡不舒服？
A 為 B 做了什麼？會說這些話的是什麼職業的人？
不要只看到單一個字（sweets、meal）就選答案。

wrong.D: 看到 sweets 就選糖果店，但 A 是叫 B 不要吃太多甜食，還要幫 B 補牙。
wrong.C: 看到 meal 就選餐廳，但對話內容是檢查和治療牙齒。
wrong.B: 看到 couldn't sleep 就聯想到旅館，但 B 睡不著是因為牙痛。

stem:
Jenny practiced the piano for three hours every day for a month before the music contest. On the day of the contest, her hands were shaking before she went on stage. But when she started to play, she forgot about everything around her. When she finished, everyone stood up and clapped for a long time. Jenny smiled with tears in her eyes.

How did Jenny probably feel at the end?
explanation: Jenny 苦練一個月，表演結束時全場起立、鼓掌很久，她 smiled with tears in her eyes（含著淚微笑），這是喜極而泣，表示她很開心、也為自己感到驕傲。上台前手發抖的緊張已經過去了。
hints: 題目問的是哪個時間點的心情？
表演結束時，觀眾有什麼反應？
一邊微笑一邊流淚，通常是什麼樣的心情？

wrong.C: 緊張發抖是她上台「之前」的心情，題目問的是表演結束時。
wrong.D: 全場起立鼓掌很久，她還面帶微笑，沒有生氣的線索。
wrong.B: 她努力練習一個月，表演後得到熱烈掌聲，不會覺得無聊。

stem:
Some students are afraid to ask questions in class. They worry about what others will think, or they don't know how they should ask. But asking questions is one of the best ways to learn. When you ask, you find out what you don't understand. Most teachers are happy when students ask questions. If you are shy, you can write down your questions and ask your teacher after class.

What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Teachers don't like students who ask questions.
Shy students should not talk in class.
Students shouldn't be afraid to ask questions.
Students should write down everything the teacher says.
explanation: 作者先說有些學生不敢發問，接著用 But 轉折，說發問是最好的學習方法之一，老師也樂於學生發問，最後給害羞的人建議。全文都在鼓勵學生不要害怕發問。
hints: 第一句提出了什麼問題？
But 之後，作者的看法是什麼？
最後一句的建議是在幫助什麼樣的學生？目的是什麼？

wrong.A: 文中說 Most teachers are happy when students ask questions.，和這句相反。
wrong.B: 作者是建議害羞的學生可以下課再問，不是叫他們不要說話。
wrong.D: 作者只建議害羞的人把「問題」寫下來，不是寫下老師說的每句話。

stem:
Three years ago, people in Green Town threw away thousands of plastic bags every day. Then the town decided to make a change. Now, stores don't give out free plastic bags, so people bring their own bags when they go shopping. Many restaurants also let people pay less if they bring their own cups. Today, there is much less plastic in the town's trash.

What is the best title for this passage?
options: How Green Town Uses Fewer Plastic Bags
A Famous Restaurant in Green Town
The Best Stores in Green Town
explanation: 文章先說三年前鎮上每天丟掉大量塑膠袋，接著說明鎮上的改變：商店不再免費提供塑膠袋、餐廳鼓勵自備杯子，結果垃圾中的塑膠少了很多。全文在說綠鎮如何減少使用塑膠袋，所以最好的標題是 How Green Town Uses Fewer Plastic Bags。
hints: 文章前後比較了綠鎮哪方面的變化？
商店和餐廳的例子都是為了說明什麼？
好的標題要能涵蓋整篇文章，而不只是其中一個細節。

wrong.D: 文中沒有比較哪些商店最好，商店只是不再免費給塑膠袋。
wrong.A: 文中沒有討論塑膠袋的價格。
wrong.C: 餐廳只是其中一個例子，而且文中沒有提到某家有名的餐廳。

stem: I ＿＿＿ a student at Hope Junior High School.
explanation: 主詞是 I（我），be 動詞固定搭配 am，所以是 I am a student.（我是學生）。is 配第三人稱單數，are 配 you、we、they 或複數。
hints: 先看主詞是誰。
I 有自己專屬的 be 動詞。

wrong.B: 以為 a student 是單數就用 is，但 be 動詞要看主詞 I，不是看後面的名詞。
wrong.C: 把 are 當成萬用的 be 動詞，忘了 I 只能配 am。
wrong.D: be 是原形，句子裡要依主詞變化成 am、is、are。

stem: The books on the desk ＿＿＿ new.
explanation: 主詞是 The books（那些書），books 有 s 是複數；on the desk 只是說明書在哪裡。複數主詞的 be 動詞用 are。
hints: 真正的主詞是 books 還是 desk？
books 是單數還是複數？

wrong.B: 看到最靠近空格的 desk 是單數就用 is，誤把 desk 當主詞。
wrong.C: am 只能和 I 搭配。
wrong.A: be 是原形，不能直接當句子的動詞。

stem: ＿＿＿ Mr. Wang your English teacher? — No, he isn't. He is our math teacher.
explanation: 答句用 he isn't，可知問句是 be 動詞疑問句；主詞 Mr. Wang 是第三人稱單數，所以把 Is 放句首：Is Mr. Wang your English teacher?
hints: 先看答句用的是 be 動詞還是助動詞。
Mr. Wang 是一個人，配哪個 be 動詞？

wrong.A: 看到 your 就以為要用 Are，但主詞是 Mr. Wang 一個人。
wrong.C: 句子裡沒有一般動詞，不能用助動詞 Do 來問。
wrong.D: Does 雖然配第三人稱單數，但答句是 isn't，表示要用 be 動詞而不是助動詞。

stem: Where ＿＿＿ my glasses? — They're on the table.
explanation: glasses（眼鏡）在英文裡一定是複數，答句也用 They're 來代替，所以 be 動詞要用 are：Where are my glasses?
hints: 答句用哪個代名詞代替 my glasses？
glasses 字尾有 es，是單數還是複數？

wrong.D: 中文說「一副眼鏡」像是單數，就用 is，忘了 glasses 是複數。
wrong.A: am 只配 I，主詞是 my glasses。
wrong.C: 句子沒有一般動詞，問「在哪裡」要用 be 動詞，不用 does。

stem: Lisa and I are good friends. ＿＿＿ are in Class 702.
explanation: Lisa and I（Lisa 和我）包含說話的人自己，代名詞要用「我們」；空格在句首當主詞，用主格 We。
hints: Lisa and I 裡面有沒有「我」？
「我們」當主詞時要用主格還是受格？

wrong.C: They 是「他們」，不包含說話者自己，但這裡有 I。
wrong.D: Us 是受格，不能放在句首當主詞。
wrong.A: She 只代替 Lisa 一個人，而且 be 動詞是 are，主詞應是複數。

stem: These are not my shoes. ＿＿＿ are under the bed.
explanation: 空格當主詞，後面直接接 are，沒有名詞，所以要用所有格代名詞 Mine（= my shoes，我的鞋子）。My 後面一定要接名詞。
hints: 空格後面有沒有接名詞？
「我的（東西）」單獨使用時要用哪個字？

wrong.D: My 是所有格形容詞，後面必須接名詞，例如 My shoes are...。
wrong.B: Me 是受格，不能當主詞，也不能表示「我的」。
wrong.A: I 是「我」，句意變成「我在床底下」，而且 I 不配 are。

stem: Mr. and Mrs. Chen are my neighbors. ＿＿＿ dog is very friendly.
explanation: 空格後面接名詞 dog，要用所有格形容詞。Mr. and Mrs. Chen 是兩個人，「他們的狗」是 Their dog。
hints: 空格後面接的是名詞還是動詞？
「他們的」後面接名詞時用哪個字？

wrong.B: They 是主格，They dog 不合文法，主格後面不能直接接名詞。
wrong.D: Them 是受格，只能放在動詞或介系詞後面。
wrong.C: Theirs 是所有格代名詞，後面不能再接名詞 dog。

stem:
A: How are you today?
B: ＿＿＿
options: Nice to meet you, too, Ken.
I'm fine, thank you. And you?
Yes, I am. I'm a student.
explanation: How are you? 是問「你好嗎？」，要回答自己的狀況，例如 I'm fine, thank you. And you?（我很好，謝謝。你呢？）。
hints: How are you? 是在問名字還是問狀況？
回答後也可以禮貌地反問對方。

wrong.D: I'm Ken. I'm from Taipei. 是自我介紹，回答 What's your name? 或 Where are you from?，不是說自己好不好。
wrong.A: Nice to meet you, too, Ken. 是回應初次見面的 Nice to meet you.
wrong.C: Yes, I am. 只能回答 Are you...? 的是非問句，How 問句不能用 Yes 回答。

stem:
A: Is that your brother?
B: ＿＿＿ He's my cousin, Sam.
explanation: B 接著說「他是我表哥 Sam」，表示那個人不是 B 的哥哥，所以要否定回答。問句用 Is，答句也用 be 動詞：No, he isn't.
hints: B 後面那句話說那個人是誰？
問句用 Is，回答要用同一種動詞。

wrong.D: 沒注意後面說他是 cousin，不是 brother，所以不能肯定回答。
wrong.A: 問句用 be 動詞 Is，答句不能改用助動詞 doesn't。
wrong.B: 問的是一個人，不能用複數 they aren't。

stem:
Hi, I'm Ryan. I'm from Canada, but my family and I are in Taiwan now. My father is an engineer, and my mother is a nurse. My sister, Kate, and I are students at Rose Junior High School. Kate is in the eighth grade, and I am in the seventh grade. Our favorite teacher is Ms. Huang. She is our music teacher.

Who is a nurse?
explanation: 文中寫 my mother is a nurse，my 指的是 Ryan，所以護理師是 Ryan 的媽媽。爸爸是工程師，Ms. Huang 是音樂老師，Kate 是學生。
hints: 找出 nurse 這個字出現在哪一句。
那一句的主詞是誰？my 指的是寫信的人。

wrong.C: 把 engineer 和 nurse 看反了，Ryan 的爸爸是工程師。
wrong.B: Ms. Huang 是他們的音樂老師，不是護理師。
wrong.A: Kate 是 Ryan 的姊姊，還在讀八年級，是學生。

stem:
These are three new students in our class.
Andy is thirteen. He is from Tainan, and he is in the art club.
Becky and Cindy are twins. They are twelve, and they are from Taichung. Becky is in the art club, but Cindy isn't. She is in the music club.

Which is TRUE?
options: The twins are thirteen years old.
Andy and Cindy are from the same city.
Cindy and Andy are in the art club.
Andy and Becky are in the same club.
explanation: Andy 在美術社（art club），Becky 也在美術社，所以 Andy 和 Becky 在同一個社團。Andy 來自臺南、雙胞胎來自臺中；雙胞胎是 12 歲；Cindy 在音樂社。
hints: 把三個人的年齡、城市、社團各自整理出來。
Becky 和 Cindy 雖然是雙胞胎，社團一樣嗎？

wrong.B: Andy 來自臺南，Cindy 來自臺中，不是同一個城市。
wrong.A: 13 歲的是 Andy，雙胞胎是 12 歲，把年齡配錯人。
wrong.C: 以為雙胞胎社團一樣，但文中說 Cindy isn't（不在美術社），她在音樂社。

stem:
Jim: Mom, this is Leo. (1)＿＿＿ is my new classmate.
Mom: Hi, Leo. Nice to meet you. Are you from Taipei?
Leo: No, I'm not. My parents and I are from Tainan, but now (2)＿＿＿ live in Taipei.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 代替 Leo 當主詞，Leo 是男生，主格用 He。(2) 代替 My parents and I（包含 Leo 自己），後面接動詞 live，要用主格「我們」we。
hints: 兩個空格後面接的都是動詞，所以都要當主詞。
My parents and I 包含說話的 Leo 自己，要用「我們」。

wrong.D: (2) 的 us 是受格，不能放在動詞 live 前面當主詞。
wrong.C: (1) 的 His 是所有格，後面要接名詞，不能直接接 is 當主詞。
wrong.B: Him 是受格、our 是所有格，兩個都不能當主詞。

stem: My mother ＿＿＿ to work at eight every morning.
explanation: every morning 表示每天的習慣，用現在簡單式。主詞 My mother 是第三人稱單數，go 要加 es 變成 goes。
hints: every morning 表示什麼樣的動作？
第三人稱單數當主詞時，動詞要怎麼變化？

wrong.B: 忘了主詞是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 es。
wrong.D: going 是 V-ing，前面沒有 be 動詞不能單獨當動詞。
wrong.A: be 動詞和一般動詞原形不能同時放在一起當動詞。

stem: We ＿＿＿ English class on Mondays and Fridays.
explanation: on Mondays and Fridays 表示每週固定的習慣，用現在簡單式。主詞 We 是複數，動詞用原形 have。
hints: 主詞 We 是第幾人稱？
has 只配哪一類主詞？

wrong.A: has 只配第三人稱單數（he、she、it），We 要用 have。
wrong.C: having 前面沒有 be 動詞，不能當句子的動詞。
wrong.B: are 和 have 不能同時當動詞，一句只需要一個主要動詞。

stem: Lucy ＿＿＿ drinks milk. She drinks a glass of it every morning.
explanation: 後一句說她每天早上都喝一杯牛奶，表示頻率是「總是」，要用 always。
hints: 後面那句說她多久喝一次牛奶？
「每天都做」對應哪一個頻率副詞？

wrong.A: never 是「從不」，和「每天早上都喝」矛盾。
wrong.D: seldom 是「很少」，和每天都喝不符。
wrong.B: sometimes 是「有時候」，但每天都喝的頻率比有時候高很多。

stem:
A: Where does your uncle work?
B: ＿＿＿
options: He goes to work by bus.
explanation: Where 問「在哪裡」，要回答地點。He works in a hospital.（他在醫院工作）說出工作地點，最合適。
hints: 問句的疑問詞是哪一個？
Where 要用什麼資訊來回答？

wrong.B: Where 開頭的問句不能用 Yes 或 No 回答。
wrong.A: He works very hard. 說的是工作的態度，回答的是 How。
wrong.C: by bus 是交通方式，回答的是 How does he go to work?

stem: My brother ＿＿＿ TV after dinner. He studies in his room.
explanation: 後句說他在房間讀書，所以前句是否定。主詞 My brother 是第三人稱單數，否定要用 doesn't，後面的動詞要用原形 watch。
hints: 主詞是第三人稱單數，否定助動詞用哪一個？
用了 doesn't 以後，動詞還要加 s 嗎？

wrong.A: don't 配 I、you、we、they，第三人稱單數要用 doesn't。
wrong.D: doesn't 後面的動詞要回到原形，不能再加 es。
wrong.B: watch 是一般動詞，否定要用助動詞，不能用 isn't。

stem: What time ＿＿＿ your father get up on Sundays? — At nine.
explanation: 句子有一般動詞 get up，疑問句要用助動詞。主詞 your father 是第三人稱單數，所以用 does，後面動詞用原形 get。
hints: 句子裡的動詞 get up 是 be 動詞還是一般動詞？
主詞 your father 是單數還是複數？

wrong.D: 看到 your 就用 do，但主詞是 your father 一個人，要用 does。
wrong.B: 句子已經有一般動詞 get up，不能再用 be 動詞 is 來問。
wrong.A: are 是 be 動詞，而且是複數，和 get up 不能搭配。

stem: Mary ＿＿＿ tired in the morning because she goes to bed late every night.
explanation: 她每晚都很晚睡，所以早上「總是」很累。頻率副詞要放在 be 動詞後面，因此是 is always tired。
hints: 她每天很晚睡，早上會累嗎？
頻率副詞遇到 be 動詞時，要放在前面還是後面？

wrong.A: 頻率副詞要放在 be 動詞後面，always is 的位置放反了。
wrong.B: tired 是形容詞，前面一定要有 be 動詞，只用 always 缺少動詞。
wrong.D: 每天晚睡應該會累，is never tired（從不累）和原因不合。

stem:
A: How often does Sam play tennis?
B: ＿＿＿
explanation: How often 是問「多常、多久一次」，要回答頻率，例如 Three times a week.（一週三次）。
hints: How often 問的是時間長度、地點，還是次數？
回答頻率常用「次數＋a week / a month」。

wrong.A: For two hours. 是回答 How long（多久的時間）。
wrong.D: In the park. 是回答 Where（在哪裡）。
wrong.B: With his father. 是回答 With whom / Who（和誰）。

stem:
A: Do you and your sister walk to school?
B: ＿＿＿ We ride our bikes.
explanation: B 說「我們騎腳踏車」，表示不是走路上學，要否定回答。問句主詞 you and your sister，回答時要用 we，助動詞用 don't。
hints: B 說他們怎麼去學校？
you and your sister 在回答時要換成哪個代名詞？

wrong.D: 沒注意後面說騎腳踏車，所以不能說 Yes。
wrong.C: 回答的人自己也在裡面，要用 we，不能用 they。
wrong.A: 問句用助動詞 Do，回答也要用 don't，不能改用 be 動詞。

stem:
Nancy loves animals. On Saturdays, she helps at an animal hospital near her home. She feeds the dogs there and cleans their rooms. On Sundays, she usually goes hiking in the mountains with her family. She seldom stays home on weekends.

Where does Nancy go on Saturdays?
explanation: 文中說 On Saturdays, she helps at an animal hospital near her home.，所以星期六她去動物醫院幫忙。去爬山是星期日的事。
hints: 找出 On Saturdays 那一句。
注意星期六和星期日做的事不一樣。

wrong.A: 看到餵狗就猜是寵物店，但文中說的是 animal hospital。
wrong.D: 去山上爬山是星期日（On Sundays）的活動。
wrong.B: 文中沒有提到去朋友家。

stem:
In Kelly's family, everyone goes out early on weekdays. Her father always takes the MRT to work. Her mother usually drives to work, but she takes the bus on rainy days. Kelly and her brother Danny live near their school, so they walk there every day. Danny never takes the bus.

It is a rainy Wednesday morning. Who takes the bus?
explanation: 星期三是平日，又是下雨天。媽媽平常開車，但 on rainy days 會搭公車，所以搭公車的是媽媽。爸爸總是搭捷運，Kelly 和 Danny 每天走路。
hints: 先確認星期三是平日，再注意「下雨」這個條件。
誰的交通方式會因為下雨而改變？

wrong.A: 爸爸 always takes the MRT，搭的是捷運不是公車。
wrong.D: Kelly 和 Danny 每天走路上學，Danny 更是 never takes the bus。
wrong.B: 只看到 usually drives，沒讀到後面 but she takes the bus on rainy days。

stem:
My grandparents live in the country. Grandpa (1)＿＿＿ up at five every day and works on the farm. Grandma (2)＿＿＿ like to get up early, so she gets up at seven.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 主詞 Grandpa 是第三人稱單數，每天的習慣用現在簡單式，get 要加 s 變 gets。(2) 奶奶七點才起床，表示她「不喜歡」早起；主詞第三人稱單數、動詞 like 是一般動詞，否定用 doesn't。
hints: 兩個空格的主詞各是誰？是單數還是複數？
(2) 後面接一般動詞 like，否定要用助動詞還是 be 動詞？

wrong.A: (1) 主詞 Grandpa 是第三人稱單數，get 要加 s。
wrong.B: (2) 主詞 Grandma 是第三人稱單數，否定要用 doesn't，不是 don't。
wrong.D: (2) like 是一般動詞，否定不能用 be 動詞 isn't。

stem: Be quiet! The baby ＿＿＿.
explanation: Be quiet!（安靜！）表示寶寶「現在正在」睡覺，用現在進行式 be + V-ing。主詞 The baby 是單數，be 動詞用 is：is sleeping。
hints: 叫大家安靜，是因為寶寶現在正在做什麼？
現在進行式的形式是什麼？主詞是單數還是複數？

wrong.C: sleeps 是現在簡單式，表示習慣，不能表達「此刻正在睡」。
wrong.B: The baby 是單數，be 動詞要用 is，不是 are。
wrong.D: 只有 V-ing 少了 be 動詞，不能構成現在進行式。

stem: ＿＿＿ careful! The floor is wet.
explanation: 祈使句用來提醒或命令，以動詞原形開頭。careful 是形容詞，前面要用 be 動詞的原形 Be：Be careful!（小心！）
hints: 這句話是在提醒別人，屬於哪一種句子？
祈使句開頭的動詞要用什麼形式？

wrong.C: Is 放句首會變成疑問句，而且句尾是驚嘆號，不是問句。
wrong.A: Are 不是原形，祈使句要用原形動詞開頭。
wrong.D: Being 是 V-ing 形式，祈使句不用 V-ing 開頭。

stem: Look! Ben and Leo ＿＿＿ soccer on the playground.
explanation: Look! 表示叫人看「現在正在發生」的事，用現在進行式。主詞 Ben and Leo 是兩個人，用 are playing。
hints: Look! 暗示動作是什麼時候發生的？
Ben and Leo 是幾個人？

wrong.A: 主詞是兩個人，be 動詞要用 are 而不是 is。
wrong.D: play 是現在簡單式，表示習慣，不能表達「看！正在踢」。
wrong.C: playing 前面少了 be 動詞。

stem:
A: What are you doing, Mary?
B: ＿＿＿
options: Yes, I am. I'm very busy.
I read comic books at home.
explanation: What are you doing? 問「你現在正在做什麼？」，要用現在進行式回答：I'm reading a comic book.（我正在看漫畫）。
hints: 問句用的是哪一種時態？
回答時要和問句用同一種時態。

wrong.C: I read comic books at home. 是現在簡單式，說的是習慣，不是現在正在做的事。
wrong.A: What 開頭的問句不能用 Yes 回答。
wrong.D: I'm Mary, Tom's sister. 是在介紹自己，但對方問的是正在做什麼。

stem: Peter is ＿＿＿ in the pool now.
explanation: is ... now 是現在進行式，要用 V-ing。swim 是「短母音＋單一子音」結尾的單音節字，要重複字尾 m 再加 ing：swimming。
hints: is 後面接什麼形式的動詞，才是現在進行式？
swim 加 ing 時，字尾子音要不要重複？

wrong.B: 知道要加 ing，但忘了 swim 要重複字尾 m。
wrong.A: swims 是現在簡單式，不能接在 is 後面。
wrong.C: swim 是原形，不能接在 be 動詞 is 後面。

stem: ＿＿＿ the students ＿＿＿ a test now? — Yes. Please be quiet.
explanation: now 表示現在正在進行，疑問句要把 be 動詞移到句首，動詞用 V-ing。主詞 the students 是複數，所以用 Are ... taking。
hints: now 提示你要用哪一種時態？
the students 是單數還是複數？動詞要用什麼形式？

wrong.C: Do ... take 是現在簡單式疑問句，問的是習慣，不是此刻。
wrong.A: the students 是複數，不能用 Is。
wrong.D: be 動詞後面的動詞要用 V-ing，Are ... take 不合文法。

stem: ＿＿＿ late again, Tim. Class starts at eight.
explanation: 否定祈使句是 Don't + 原形動詞。late 是形容詞，前面需要 be，所以是 Don't be late.（不要遲到）。
hints: 否定的祈使句要怎麼開頭？
late 是形容詞還是動詞？前面需要什麼？

wrong.A: late 是形容詞，Don't 後面要先接原形動詞 be。
wrong.B: 祈使句的否定要用 Don't，不能只用 Not。
wrong.C: 祈使句沒有主詞，否定一律用 Don't，不用 Doesn't。

stem: It's raining. Let's ＿＿＿ out today. Let's watch a movie at home.
explanation: Let's 的否定是 Let's not + 原形動詞，所以「我們今天不要出去」是 Let's not go out today.
hints: Let's 後面接什麼形式的動詞？
Let's 的否定，not 要放在哪裡？

wrong.C: 一般祈使句否定用 Don't，但 Let's 的否定是 Let's not，不是 Let's don't。
wrong.A: Let's 後面要接原形動詞，不能接 V-ing。
wrong.D: no 不能用來否定動詞，要用 not。

stem:
A: Please pass me the salt.
B: ＿＿＿
explanation: A 請 B 把鹽遞過來，B 把東西交給對方時常說 Here you are.（拿去吧／給你）。
hints: A 是在道謝、道歉，還是請別人做事？
把東西交給別人時通常說什麼？

wrong.B: You're welcome. 是對方說謝謝時的回答。
wrong.A: That's all right. 多用來回應對方的道歉。
wrong.D: I'm sorry to hear that. 是聽到壞消息時的回應。

stem:
It is seven o'clock in the evening at the Lins' house. Mr. Lin is cooking dinner in the kitchen. His son, Jim, is putting bowls and chopsticks on the table. Mrs. Lin is in the living room. She is talking with Grandma on the phone. Their daughter, Amy, is taking a bath.

What is Mrs. Lin doing?
options: She is talking with Grandma on the phone.
She is putting bowls on the table.
explanation: 文中說 Mrs. Lin is in the living room. She is talking with Grandma on the phone.，所以林太太正在和奶奶講電話。煮飯的是林先生。
hints: 找到 Mrs. Lin 出現的句子。
後面那句的 She 指的是誰？

wrong.D: 煮晚餐的是 Mr. Lin，不是 Mrs. Lin。
wrong.A: 在洗澡的是女兒 Amy。
wrong.C: 擺碗筷的是兒子 Jim。

stem:
Museum Notice
1. Please keep your voice down.
2. Don't touch the paintings.
3. Don't take photos in Room A. Photos are OK in Room B.

Which visitor is NOT following the rules?
options: Leo is taking photos in Room B.
Ken is taking photos of the paintings in Room A.
Amy is talking quietly with her mom in Room B.
Sue is looking at the paintings in Room A.
explanation: 第 3 條規定在 A 室不能拍照，Ken 卻在 A 室拍畫作，違反規定。Amy 小聲說話符合第 1 條；B 室可以拍照；只是看畫沒有碰觸，也沒有違規。
hints: 把每個人的行為和三條規則一一對照。
拍照的規定在 A 室和 B 室有什麼不同？

wrong.C: 規定是降低音量，小聲說話（talking quietly）是遵守規則。
wrong.A: 第 3 條說 B 室可以拍照，Leo 沒有違規。
wrong.D: 規定是不能碰畫，只是看畫沒有違規。

stem:
It is three o'clock on Saturday afternoon. Right now, my dad (1)＿＿＿ the car outside, and my brothers are helping him. My mom is in the kitchen. She (2)＿＿＿ a cake for my grandma's birthday.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: Right now（就在現在）表示兩個動作都正在進行，都要用現在進行式。(1) 主詞 my dad 是單數，用 is washing；(2) 主詞 She 是單數，用 is making。
hints: Right now 告訴你這些動作是什麼時候發生的？
兩個空格的主詞各是單數還是複數？

wrong.B: (1) washes 是現在簡單式，表示習慣，但 Right now 是正在進行的動作。
wrong.A: (2) makes 是現在簡單式，媽媽此刻正在做蛋糕，要用 is making。
wrong.C: (1) 主詞是 my dad 一個人，雖然後面提到哥哥們，be 動詞仍要用 is。

stem: My grandparents ＿＿＿ in Tainan ten years ago. Now they live in Taipei.
explanation: ten years ago（十年前）是過去的時間，要用過去式。live 字尾是 e，直接加 d 變成 lived。
hints: ten years ago 指的是現在還是過去？
規則動詞的過去式怎麼變化？

wrong.D: live 是現在式，但 ten years ago 是過去的時間。
wrong.C: lives 是第三人稱單數現在式，而且主詞是複數。
wrong.A: living 前面沒有 be 動詞，不能當動詞。

stem: I ＿＿＿ a great movie with my friends last Saturday.
explanation: last Saturday（上週六）是過去，要用過去式。see 是不規則動詞，過去式是 saw。
hints: last Saturday 表示什麼時候？
see 的過去式是規則變化嗎？

wrong.B: see 是現在式，沒有配合過去時間 last Saturday。
wrong.A: 把 see 當成規則動詞加 d，但 see 是不規則動詞。
wrong.D: seen 是過去分詞，不能單獨當過去式動詞。

stem: I ＿＿＿ very tired yesterday, so I went to bed early.
explanation: yesterday 是過去的時間，be 動詞要用過去式。主詞 I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was。
hints: yesterday 是過去還是現在？
am 的過去式是什麼？

wrong.A: am 是現在式，和 yesterday 不合。
wrong.D: were 用在 you、we、they 或複數主詞，I 要用 was。
wrong.C: is 是現在式，而且不配主詞 I。

stem:
A: Did you have a good weekend?
B: ＿＿＿
options: Yes, I did. I went hiking with my dad.
No, I wasn't. I was at home all day.
Yes, I do. I go hiking with my dad.
Yes, I will. I'll go hiking with my dad.
explanation: 問句用 Did，問的是過去的週末，回答也要用 did，後面補充的內容也用過去式 went。
hints: 問句用了哪個助動詞？
回答時要和問句用相同的時態。

wrong.C: do 和 go 是現在式，但問的是已經過去的週末。
wrong.B: 問句用助動詞 Did，不能用 be 動詞 wasn't 回答。
wrong.D: will 是未來式，問的是過去的事。

stem: Lisa ＿＿＿ to the party last night. She stayed home.
explanation: 她待在家裡，所以昨晚沒有去派對。過去式否定用 didn't，後面接原形動詞 go：didn't go。
hints: last night 要用什麼時態？
didn't 後面的動詞要用什麼形式？

wrong.C: doesn't 是現在式，和 last night 不合。
wrong.B: didn't 已經表示過去，後面的動詞要用原形 go，不能用 went。
wrong.A: go 是一般動詞，否定要用 didn't，不能用 be 動詞 wasn't。

stem: The baby ＿＿＿ a lot last night, so his parents didn't sleep well.
explanation: last night 要用過去式。cry 是「子音＋y」結尾，要把 y 改成 i 再加 ed：cried。
hints: last night 要用什麼時態？
動詞以「子音＋y」結尾時，加 ed 前要怎麼改？

wrong.A: 忘了「子音＋y」結尾要先把 y 改成 i 再加 ed。
wrong.C: cries 是現在式，和 last night 不合。
wrong.B: crys 拼法錯誤，而且也不是過去式。

stem: Ms. Lee ＿＿＿ us a funny story in class yesterday.
explanation: yesterday 要用過去式。tell 是不規則動詞，過去式是 told，不是加 ed。
hints: yesterday 表示什麼時態？
tell 的過去式是規則變化嗎？

wrong.C: 把 tell 當成規則動詞加 ed，但 tell 的過去式是 told。
wrong.A: tells 是現在式，和 yesterday 不合。
wrong.D: tell 是原形，沒有配合過去時間。

stem: Mike ＿＿＿ a bad cold last week, but he's fine now.
explanation: last week 是過去，「得了感冒」要用過去式。have 是不規則動詞，過去式是 had。
hints: 感冒是上週還是現在的事？
have 的過去式是什麼？

wrong.C: has 是現在式，但感冒發生在 last week。
wrong.A: have 是不規則動詞，沒有 haved 這個字。
wrong.D: have 是原形，而且主詞是第三人稱單數，也不能用 have 當現在式。

stem:
A: When did you come back from Japan?
B: ＿＿＿
explanation: When 問「什麼時候」，要回答時間點。Two days ago.（兩天前）說出回來的時間，最合適。
hints: 問句的疑問詞是什麼？
When 要用時間點還是時間長度來回答？

wrong.D: For five days. 是時間長度，回答的是 How long。
wrong.C: By plane. 是交通方式，回答的是 How。
wrong.A: With my parents. 是同伴，回答的是 Who / With whom。

stem:
Sunday, October 5
Today I went to the night market with my cousin. We ate stinky tofu and played some games. I won a big teddy bear! At nine, it rained very hard, so we took a taxi home. It was a fun night.

How did the writer go home?
explanation: 日記寫 it rained very hard, so we took a taxi home.，因為下大雨，所以作者搭計程車回家。
hints: 找出和「回家」有關的那一句。
took a taxi 是什麼意思？

wrong.A: 文中沒有提到搭公車。
wrong.C: 下大雨所以沒有走路回家，文中說的是搭計程車。
wrong.D: 文中沒有提到捷運。

stem:
Last Sunday, I (1)＿＿＿ a long letter to my pen pal in Japan. I also (2)＿＿＿ some photos of Taiwan in the letter. I hope she likes them.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: Last Sunday 是過去，兩個動詞都要用過去式。write 的過去式是不規則的 wrote；put 的過去式和原形一樣，仍是 put。
hints: Last Sunday 表示要用哪一種時態？
write 和 put 都是不規則動詞，有一個的過去式和原形長得一樣。

wrong.C: write 是不規則動詞，過去式是 wrote，不是 writed。
wrong.D: put 的過去式還是 put，不能加 ted。
wrong.A: write 和 puts 都是現在式，沒有配合 Last Sunday。

stem:
Yesterday, Ken left home at 7:20. He walked to the MRT station in 10 minutes. Then he took the MRT, and the trip took 25 minutes. After he got off the MRT, he walked for 5 more minutes to his school.

What time did Ken get to school?
explanation: 把每段時間加起來：走到捷運站 10 分鐘＋搭捷運 25 分鐘＋再走 5 分鐘＝40 分鐘。7:20 再加 40 分鐘是 8:00。
hints: Ken 去學校分成哪幾段路？
把所有段落的分鐘數加起來，再從 7:20 往後算。

wrong.D: 漏算最後走路的 5 分鐘，只算到 35 分鐘。
wrong.B: 漏算第一段走到捷運站的 10 分鐘。
wrong.A: 多加了 5 分鐘，可能把最後的走路時間算了兩次。

stem: My uncle will ＿＿＿ us next week.
explanation: will 是助動詞，後面一定接原形動詞，所以是 will visit。next week 也表示未來。
hints: will 後面要接什麼形式的動詞？
主詞是第三人稱單數，用了 will 以後動詞還要加 s 嗎？

wrong.B: 看到主詞 My uncle 是第三人稱單數就加 s，但 will 後面要用原形。
wrong.A: visited 是過去式，和 will、next week 不合。
wrong.C: will 後面不接 V-ing。

stem: Ann ＿＿＿ speak three languages: Chinese, English, and Japanese.
explanation: can 表示「能夠、會」，是助動詞，沒有人稱變化，後面直接接原形動詞：Ann can speak...。
hints: can 是一般動詞還是助動詞？
助動詞後面接什麼？會不會因為主詞加 s？

wrong.C: 助動詞 can 不會因為第三人稱單數加 s。
wrong.D: can 後面直接接原形動詞，不需要 to。
wrong.B: can 已經是助動詞，前面不能再加 be 動詞。

stem: We are going to ＿＿＿ a party for Mom next Sunday.
explanation: be going to 表示「打算、將要」，to 後面要接原形動詞，所以是 are going to have。
hints: be going to 的 to 後面接什麼形式？
主詞 We 之後已經有 are，空格只要填原形。

wrong.D: has 是第三人稱單數現在式，to 後面要用原形。
wrong.B: going to 後面不接 V-ing，having 不正確。
wrong.A: had 是過去式，和 next Sunday 以及 to 都不合。

stem:
A: What are you going to do this weekend?
B: ＿＿＿
options: Yes, I am. I'm very excited about it.
I visited my aunt in Tainan last week.
I'm going to visit my aunt in Tainan.
I visit my aunt in Tainan every day.
explanation: 問句用 be going to 問「這個週末打算做什麼」，回答也用 be going to 說出計畫：I'm going to visit my aunt in Tainan.
hints: 問的是過去、習慣，還是未來的計畫？
回答時用和問句相同的句型。

wrong.B: visited 和 last week 是過去式，說的是上週的事，但問的是還沒到的週末。
wrong.A: What 開頭的問句不能用 Yes 回答。
wrong.D: every day 是每天的習慣，沒有回答週末的計畫。

stem: Mr. Wu ＿＿＿ in Taipei next year. His family is going to move to Tainan this summer.
explanation: 他們家今年夏天要搬去臺南，所以吳先生明年「將不會」在臺北工作。next year 是未來，否定用 won't + 原形動詞。
hints: next year 是什麼時間？要用什麼時態？
won't 後面的動詞要用什麼形式？

wrong.B: doesn't work 是現在式，表示現在的習慣，但說的是明年。
wrong.A: didn't work 是過去式，和 next year 矛盾。
wrong.C: won't 是助動詞，後面要接原形 work，不能加 s。

stem:
A: Will Jenny come to the meeting tomorrow?
B: ＿＿＿ She is sick in bed.
explanation: B 說 Jenny 生病躺在床上，所以明天不會來，要否定回答。問句用 Will，回答也用 will 的否定 won't。
hints: Jenny 現在身體狀況如何？明天會來嗎？
問句用什麼助動詞，回答就用什麼。

wrong.D: 她生病臥床，說她會來和後面的理由矛盾。
wrong.A: 問句用 Will，回答不能改用 be 動詞 isn't。
wrong.C: 問句用 Will，回答不能改用 doesn't。

stem: You ＿＿＿ talk loudly in the library. Other people are reading.
explanation: 圖書館裡有人在看書，所以「不可以」大聲說話，表示禁止要用 mustn't（must not）。
hints: 後一句說明了什麼原因？
表示「禁止、不可以」要用哪個助動詞？

wrong.B: don't have to 是「不必」，表示可做可不做，不是禁止。
wrong.D: must 是「必須」，變成「你必須大聲說話」，意思相反。
wrong.C: can 是「可以」，和別人在看書的情境矛盾。

stem: My little brother is only two years old. He ＿＿＿ read or write.
explanation: 兩歲的小孩還沒有讀寫的能力，表示「不會、不能」要用 can't。
hints: 兩歲小孩做不到這件事，是因為被禁止還是沒有能力？
表示「能力上做不到」要用哪個助動詞？

wrong.C: mustn't 是「禁止」，但讀書寫字不是被禁止的事。
wrong.A: doesn't have to 是「不必」，沒有表達出能力不足的意思。
wrong.D: shouldn't 是「不應該」，讀寫並不是不應該做的事。

stem:
A: I have a bad toothache.
B: ＿＿＿
options: You don't have to brush your teeth.
explanation: A 說牙齒很痛，合理的建議是 You should see a dentist.（你應該去看牙醫），should 用來給建議。
hints: A 遇到了什麼問題？
給別人建議時常用哪個助動詞？

wrong.D: 牙痛還要多吃糖果，建議不合理。
wrong.C: 牙痛時更需要刷牙，說不必刷牙不合常理。
wrong.B: I'll be there on time. 是答應準時到，和牙痛無關。

stem:
Class 801 Field Trip
We will go to the Science Museum this Friday. Please meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m. You should wear your school uniform. You don't have to bring lunch. The school will give everyone a lunch box.

Which is TRUE?
options: The school will give the students lunch.
The students don't have to wear school uniforms.
The students will meet at the museum.
The students must bring their lunch.
explanation: 通知最後說 The school will give everyone a lunch box.，所以學校會提供午餐。集合地點是校門口；不必帶午餐；應該穿制服。
hints: 逐一核對集合地點、服裝和午餐三件事。
You don't have to bring lunch. 的原因寫在下一句。

wrong.C: 集合地點是 the school gate（校門口），不是博物館。
wrong.D: 通知說 You don't have to bring lunch.（不必帶午餐）。
wrong.B: 通知說 You should wear your school uniform.，應該穿制服。

stem:
Mia: Mom, can I go to Amy's house tonight?
Mom: Yes, but you (1)＿＿＿ finish your homework before you go. That's our rule.
Mia: OK. Do I have to take the bus there?
Mom: No, you (2)＿＿＿. Dad will drive you.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) 媽媽說 That's our rule.（這是我們的規定），表示「必須」先寫完作業，用 must。(2) 回答 Do I have to...? 的否定是 No, you don't have to.（不必），因為爸爸會載她。
hints: (1) 後面的 That's our rule. 表示這件事是必須還是可有可無？
回答 Do I have to...? 的否定時，要說「不必」還是「禁止」？

wrong.A: (2) mustn't 是「禁止」，但搭公車並沒有被禁止，只是爸爸會載她所以不必。
wrong.D: (1) 有家規要求先寫完作業，不能說 don't have to（不必）。
wrong.C: (1) can't finish 是「不能寫完」，和「寫完才能去」的意思不合。

stem:
Ben: Are you free after school next week, Jason? Let's play basketball.
Jason: Let me see. I'm going to see the dentist on Tuesday, and I'll help my mom at her shop on Thursday. On Friday, my family is going to have dinner at Grandpa's house.
Ben: How about Monday or Wednesday?
Jason: Monday is OK. On Wednesday I have a piano lesson.

When will they probably play basketball?
explanation: Jason 星期二看牙醫、星期三上鋼琴課、星期四幫媽媽顧店、星期五去爺爺家吃飯，只有星期一有空，他也說 Monday is OK.，所以他們應該星期一打球。
hints: 把 Jason 每天的計畫列出來。
哪一天 Jason 說可以？

wrong.D: 星期二 Jason 要去看牙醫。
wrong.B: Ben 提議過星期三，但 Jason 那天有鋼琴課。
wrong.A: 星期四 Jason 要去媽媽的店幫忙。

stem: In Taiwan, summer is ＿＿＿ than spring.
explanation: 有 than 表示兩者比較，用比較級。hot 是「短母音＋單一子音」結尾，要重複 t 再加 er：hotter。
hints: 句子裡有 than，要用原級、比較級還是最高級？
hot 加 er 時字尾要不要重複？

wrong.B: 知道加 er，但忘了 hot 要重複字尾 t。
wrong.C: hot 是單音節形容詞，比較級直接加 er，不用 more。
wrong.D: hottest 是最高級，有 than 要用比較級。

stem: Mount Jade is the ＿＿＿ mountain in Taiwan.
explanation: 玉山在臺灣所有山裡最高，「在某範圍內最…」要用最高級：the highest。前面已經有 the。
hints: in Taiwan 表示在一個範圍裡比較，用哪一級？
high 的最高級怎麼變化？

wrong.C: higher 是比較級，用在兩者比較，而且通常搭配 than。
wrong.D: high 是原級，沒有表達「最」的意思。
wrong.B: high 是單音節字，最高級直接加 est，不用 most。

stem: This story is ＿＿＿ than that one. I can't stop reading it.
explanation: 有 than 要用比較級。interesting 是多音節形容詞，比較級要在前面加 more：more interesting。
hints: 看到 than 要用哪一級？
長的形容詞（三個音節以上）比較級要怎麼變？

wrong.A: interesting 是長形容詞，不能直接加 er。
wrong.D: most interesting 是最高級，有 than 要用比較級。
wrong.C: interesting 是原級，不能和 than 搭配。

stem: My bag is as ＿＿＿ as yours. They both cost NT$500.
explanation: 兩個包包價錢一樣，用「as + 原級 + as」表示「和……一樣」，中間要放原級形容詞 cheap。
hints: 兩個包包的價錢一樣還是不一樣？
as ... as 中間要放哪一級的形容詞？

wrong.C: as ... as 中間要放原級，不能放比較級 cheaper。
wrong.D: cheapest 是最高級，不能放在 as ... as 中間。
wrong.B: cheap 的比較級是 cheaper，沒有 more cheap，而且 as ... as 中間要用原級。

stem: Tom's English is good, but his sister's English is even ＿＿＿.
explanation: even（更加）用來加強比較級。good 的比較級是不規則的 better，所以是 even better（更好）。
hints: even 後面通常接哪一級的形容詞？
good 的比較級是規則變化嗎？

wrong.A: good 是不規則變化，沒有 gooder 這個字。
wrong.D: best 是最高級，even 用來修飾比較級。
wrong.C: good 的比較級是 better，不用 more good。

stem: Of all the students in my class, Leo runs ＿＿＿.
explanation: Of all the students in my class（在全班同學中）表示三者以上比較，要用最高級 the fastest。
hints: Of all the students 表示比較的對象有幾個？
fast 的最高級怎麼變化？

wrong.B: faster 是比較級，用在兩者比較，這裡是全班比較。
wrong.C: fast 是原級，沒有表達「最快」。
wrong.A: fast 是單音節字，最高級是 fastest，不用 most。

stem: In Taiwan, winter is ＿＿＿ season of the year.
explanation: season of the year 表示在一年四季中比較，四季中最冷用最高級，而且最高級前面要加 the：the coldest。
hints: 一年有幾個季節？是兩者比較還是多者比較？
最高級前面通常要加什麼？

wrong.B: colder 是比較級，四季比較要用最高級。
wrong.C: the colder 用在兩者之中，這裡是四個季節。
wrong.A: 最高級前面少了 the，is coldest season 不合文法。

stem: Ken is 165 cm tall, and Paul is 165 cm tall, too. Ken is ＿＿＿ Paul.
explanation: 兩人都是 165 公分，一樣高，用「as + 原級 + as」：Ken is as tall as Paul.
hints: 兩人的身高一樣嗎？
表示「一樣……」的句型是什麼？中間放哪一級？

wrong.D: 兩人一樣高，不能說 Ken 比較高。
wrong.B: as ... as 中間要放原級 tall，不能放比較級。
wrong.A: 兩人一樣高，不能說 Ken 比較矮。

stem:
A: Which is ＿＿＿, a bike or a car?
B: A car, of course.
explanation: 問句在腳踏車和汽車「兩者」之間比較，用比較級。fast 是單音節字，比較級是 faster。
hints: 問句裡比較的東西有幾個？
兩者比較要用比較級還是最高級？

wrong.A: fastest 是最高級，用在三者以上，這裡只有兩樣東西。
wrong.B: fast 是原級，加 the 也不能表示比較。
wrong.D: fast 是單音節字，比較級直接加 er，不用 more。

stem:
Tim is looking at three backpacks in a store. The red one is NT$800. The blue one is NT$600, and it is the lightest of the three. The green one is NT$1,000, and it is the biggest.

Tim wants the cheapest backpack. Which one will he buy?
explanation: 三個背包的價錢：紅色 800 元、藍色 600 元、綠色 1,000 元，最便宜的是藍色，所以 Tim 會買藍色的。
hints: 把三個背包的價錢列出來比較。
cheapest 是「最便宜」，找價錢最低的。

wrong.D: 紅色 800 元，比藍色的 600 元貴。
wrong.C: 綠色 1,000 元是最貴的。
wrong.A: 最大的是綠色背包，也是最貴的，不符合 Tim 要最便宜的條件。

stem:
Mia: Excuse me. Which jacket is (1)＿＿＿, the black one or the white one?
Clerk: The black one. It's NT$1,500, and the white one is only NT$1,200.
Mia: Then I'll take the white one. It's (2)＿＿＿, and it looks nice, too.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: 店員回答「黑色的，1,500 元，白色的只要 1,200 元」，表示 Mia 問的是哪件比較貴，(1) 用 more expensive。Mia 選白色的，因為它比較便宜，(2) 用 cheaper。
hints: 店員回答黑色的，並說白色的「只要」1,200 元，Mia 問的是比較貴還是比較便宜？
expensive 和 cheap 的比較級各怎麼變化？

wrong.B: 把兩個空格的意思弄反了：店員回答黑色，而黑色比較貴。
wrong.C: expensive 是長形容詞，比較級是 more expensive，沒有 expensiver。
wrong.A: cheap 是單音節字，比較級是 cheaper，不是 more cheap。

stem:
How to get from Green Town to Blue Lake:
By train: 2 hours, NT$450
By bus: 4 hours, NT$300
By plane: 40 minutes, NT$1,800

Which is TRUE?
options: The plane is the fastest, and it is cheaper than the train.
The bus is as fast as the train, but it costs less.
The bus is the cheapest, but it is also the slowest.
The train is faster than the plane, and it costs less.
explanation: 比較價錢：公車 300 元最便宜；比較時間：公車 4 小時最久，所以公車最便宜也最慢。飛機 40 分鐘最快；飛機 1,800 元比火車貴；公車 4 小時比火車 2 小時慢。
hints: 分別比較三種交通方式的「時間」和「價錢」。
花的時間越長，表示越快還是越慢？

wrong.D: 火車比飛機便宜沒錯，但火車要 2 小時，飛機只要 40 分鐘，飛機比較快。
wrong.A: 飛機最快沒錯，但飛機 1,800 元，火車 450 元，飛機比較貴。
wrong.B: 公車比火車便宜沒錯，但公車要 4 小時，火車 2 小時，兩者速度不一樣。

stem: Kevin is good at ＿＿＿ pictures. He wants to be an artist.
explanation: be good at 的 at 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動詞要改成動名詞（V-ing），所以要用 drawing。be good at drawing pictures 意思是「擅長畫畫」。
hints: 空格前面的 at 是什麼詞性？
介系詞後面如果接動詞，要變成什麼形式？

wrong.A: 以為空格前面有 is 就可以直接接原形動詞，忽略了 at 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing。
wrong.B: 把 to 不定詞和介系詞後的動名詞搞混了；at 後面不能再接 to V。
wrong.D: 以為主詞 Kevin 是第三人稱單數就要加 s，但這裡空格在介系詞 at 後面，不是句子的主要動詞。

stem: Joy hopes ＿＿＿ her grandparents in Japan this summer.
explanation: hope（希望）後面接動詞時，要用不定詞 to V，所以是 hopes to visit her grandparents，意思是「希望今年夏天去日本看爺爺奶奶」。
hints: hope 後面接另一個動詞時，要用 to V 還是 V-ing？
句子裡已經有一個動詞 hopes，第二個動詞不能直接用原形。

wrong.B: 句子已經有動詞 hopes，第二個動詞不能直接接原形，要用 to visit。
wrong.D: 把 hope 和 enjoy 這類接 V-ing 的動詞搞混了；hope 要接 to V。
wrong.A: 看到動作還沒發生卻用了過去式；而且 hope 後面要接 to V，不能接過去式動詞。

stem: Would you mind ＿＿＿ the window? It's hot in here.
explanation: mind（介意）後面接動詞要用動名詞 V-ing。Would you mind opening the window? 是很有禮貌的請求，意思是「你介意打開窗戶嗎？」。
hints: mind 是「介意」的意思，它後面接動詞的習慣用法是哪一種？
和 enjoy、finish 一樣，mind 後面接的動詞要加 -ing 嗎？

wrong.B: 以為 Would you 後面都接原形動詞，但這裡原形動詞是 mind，第二個動詞 open 要改成 V-ing。
wrong.A: 把 mind 和 want、would like 這類接 to V 的動詞搞混了；mind 後面要接 V-ing。
wrong.C: 以為 Would 是過去式所以後面也要用過去式，但 mind 後面要接 V-ing。

stem: It's ten o'clock. It's time ＿＿＿ to bed, kids.
explanation: It's time to + 原形動詞 表示「該做某事的時候了」，所以要用 to go。It's time to go to bed. 意思是「該上床睡覺了」。
hints: 「該是做……的時候了」英文怎麼說？
It's time 後面接動詞時，要先加哪一個小字？

wrong.B: 句子已經有動詞 is（It's），go 不能直接放在 time 後面，要用 to go。
wrong.C: 把 It's time to V 記成接 V-ing 了；這個句型要用不定詞。
wrong.D: 說的是現在該去睡覺，不是過去；而且 It's time 後面要接 to V，不能接過去式。

stem: I'm tired of ＿＿＿ the same lunch every day. Let's try something new.
explanation: be tired of 表示「對……感到厭倦」，of 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動詞要用 V-ing，所以是 tired of eating the same lunch（每天吃一樣的午餐吃膩了）。
hints: be tired of 的 of 是什麼詞性？
介系詞後面接動詞的規則和 be good at 一樣嗎？

wrong.A: 看到前面有 I'm 就以為接原形，忽略了 of 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing。
wrong.D: 以為兩個動詞之間要用 to 連接，但 of 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing 而不是 to V。
wrong.C: 以為每天吃的事情是過去發生的就用過去式；介系詞後面不能接過去式動詞。

stem: I can't decide what ＿＿＿ for Mom's birthday. Can you give me some ideas?
explanation: 「疑問詞 + to V」可以當名詞用，例如 what to buy（要買什麼）、how to do（怎麼做）。decide what to buy for Mom's birthday 意思是「決定要買什麼給媽媽當生日禮物」。
hints: what 後面接動詞，可以組成「要……什麼」的片語。
想想 how to swim、where to go 這類片語的結構。

wrong.B: 把「疑問詞 + to V」記成「疑問詞 + V-ing」；what 後面要接 to V。
wrong.A: what 後面直接接原形 buy 缺少主詞，不是完整的用法，要用 what to buy。
wrong.D: 以為買東西的動作已經發生，但說話者還沒決定要買什麼，而且這裡要用 what to buy 的結構。

stem: Remember ＿＿＿ the lights when you leave the classroom. We need to save energy.
explanation: remember to V 表示「記得要去做（還沒做的事）」，remember V-ing 表示「記得曾經做過某事」。這句是提醒離開教室時要關燈，動作還沒發生，所以用 to turn off。
hints: 關燈這件事是已經做了，還是離開教室時才要去做？
remember to V 和 remember V-ing 的意思有什麼不同？

wrong.A: remember V-ing 是「記得做過某事」，但關燈是之後才要做的事，要用 remember to V。
wrong.D: 句子的動詞已經是 Remember，第二個動詞不能直接用原形，要用 to turn off。
wrong.C: 以為提醒的是已經做完的事而用過去式；remember 後面不能接過去式動詞。

stem:
A: Would you mind turning down the TV? I'm studying.
B: ＿＿＿ I'll do it right now.
explanation: Would you mind + V-ing? 字面意思是「你介意……嗎？」，答應對方時要說「不介意」，常用 Not at all.（一點也不介意）。B 後面說 I'll do it right now.（我馬上做），表示答應，所以選 Not at all.
hints: mind 是「介意」，對方問「你介意把電視轉小聲嗎？」
如果願意幫忙，應該回答「介意」還是「不介意」？

wrong.C: Yes, please. 是接受別人提供東西或幫忙時說的，不能用來回答 Would you mind…?
wrong.D: Yes, I would like. 本身文法不完整（like 後面少了受詞），也不是回答 Would you mind 的說法。
wrong.B: No, thanks. 是拒絕別人好意時說的，不能用來答應對方的請求。

stem:
Hi, I'm Ivy. Last summer, I learned to swim. At first, I was afraid of putting my face into the water. My coach told me not to worry and taught me to breathe slowly. After two weeks of practicing, I could swim 25 meters. Now I enjoy swimming with my friends every weekend.

What was Ivy afraid of at first?
options: Putting her face into the water
explanation: 文中說 At first, I was afraid of putting my face into the water.（一開始我害怕把臉放進水裡），所以答案是把臉放進水裡。游 25 公尺是練習兩週後做到的事，和朋友游泳是她現在喜歡的事。
hints: 找出文章裡 At first 那一句。
afraid of 後面接的是什麼動作？

wrong.C: 和朋友游泳是 Ivy 現在每週末喜歡做的事（enjoy swimming），不是一開始害怕的事。
wrong.B: 文中教練只是叫她不要擔心，並沒有說她害怕和教練說話。
wrong.A: 游 25 公尺是她練習兩週後的成果，不是一開始害怕的事。

stem:
Library Notice
Starting next Monday, students can borrow up to five books at a time. Please remember to return them within two weeks. Eating and drinking are not allowed in the library. Talking on the phone is not allowed, either. Thank you for helping keep the library a quiet place to study.

What is this notice mainly about?
options: How to write a book report
explanation: 公告說明一次能借幾本書、要在兩週內還書、不能飲食、不能講電話，這些都是使用圖書館的規定，所以主旨是「學生使用圖書館的規則」。
hints: 公告裡的每一句都在告訴學生什麼？
借書、還書、不能吃東西、不能講電話，這些可以合稱為什麼？

wrong.C: 公告沒有提到怎麼寫讀書心得，只提到借書和使用圖書館的規定。
wrong.B: 公告雖然提到借書，但沒有介紹任何新書。
wrong.D: next Monday 是新借書規定開始的日子，不是閱讀比賽。

stem:
Last year, Grandpa's doctor told him (1)＿＿＿ smoking. It wasn't easy, but Grandpa finally did it. Now he is much healthier, and he spends an hour (2)＿＿＿ in the park every morning.

Which is the best choice for (1) and (2)?
explanation: (1) tell + 人 + to V 表示「告訴某人去做某事」，所以是 told him to stop smoking（叫他戒菸），stop 後面接 V-ing 表示停止做某事。(2) spend + 時間 + V-ing 表示「花時間做某事」，所以是 spends an hour walking。
hints: (1) 醫生「叫爺爺去做」某事，tell 後面接人之後要接什麼形式的動詞？
(2)「花多少時間做某事」英文是 spend + 時間 + 哪一種動詞形式？

wrong.D: tell + 人 後面要接 to V，不能接 V-ing；(1) 要用 to stop。
wrong.C: spend + 時間 後面要接 V-ing，不能接 to V；(2) 要用 walking。
wrong.A: tell + 人 後面不能直接接原形動詞，spend + 時間 後面也不能接原形動詞。

stem:
Ben used to spend three hours playing video games every night. Last month, his parents asked him to change this habit. Now Ben stops playing games at nine and reads for half an hour before going to bed. Yesterday, on his way home, he stopped to buy a new comic book. He plans to finish reading it this weekend.

Which is TRUE about Ben?
options: He doesn't play video games at all now.
He read the whole new comic book yesterday.
His parents told him to play games for three hours.
He bought a comic book on his way home yesterday.
explanation: stop V-ing 是「停止做某事」，stop to V 是「停下來去做另一件事」。文中 he stopped to buy a new comic book 表示他昨天回家途中停下來去買漫畫，所以 D 正確。他只是九點停止玩遊戲，並沒有完全不玩；漫畫打算週末看完；父母是要他改掉每晚玩三小時的習慣。
hints: 注意 stops playing 和 stopped to buy 的意思不一樣。
stopped to buy 是「停止買」還是「停下來去買」？
plans to finish reading it this weekend 表示漫畫看完了沒？

wrong.A: 文中說他九點停止玩遊戲（stops playing games at nine），表示他還是會玩，只是每天限制時間，不是完全不玩。
wrong.B: 文中說他打算這個週末看完（plans to finish reading it this weekend），昨天只是買了書。
wrong.C: 每晚玩三小時是他以前的習慣，父母是要他改掉這個習慣，不是叫他玩三小時。

stem: Which do you like better, cats ＿＿＿ dogs?
explanation: Which do you like better 是在問「兩者之中比較喜歡哪一個」，要在兩個選項之間做選擇，所以用表示「或者」的 or：cats or dogs（貓還是狗）。
hints: 這句是要對方「兩個都選」還是「選其中一個」？
表示「或者、還是」的連接詞是哪一個？

wrong.D: and 表示「和」，是把兩者加在一起；但 Which…better 是要對方二選一，要用 or。
wrong.A: but 表示前後語意相反，cats 和 dogs 之間沒有轉折的關係。
wrong.B: so 表示「所以」，用來連接因果關係的兩個句子，不能連接兩個選項。
